name: SONY
description: "This is a bookshelf type speaker system that utilizes the know-how accumulated through the APM-6Monitor and adopts SONY's original APM unit.In the APM speaker, the flat diaphragm eliminates the cavity effect, which is the resonance phenomenon of air that occurs in the conventional megaphone-shaped cone, and prevents the frequency characteristics from being disturbed.This flat diaphragm adopts the honeycomb sandwich structure used in aircraft and Shinkansen bodies. By sandwiching the honeycomb core in the shape of a hexagonal honeycomb honeycomb with two sheets of skin made of aluminum foil, the bending rigidity reaches 500 to 1000 times that of the conventional cone type, and deformation is suppressed to 1/20 to 1/30 even in actual use. This has succeeded in minimizing split vibration.In addition, the vibration pattern of the diaphragm is simplified by adopting a square shape with a simpler division vibration pattern than the round shape, and the division vibration of a specific mode is eliminated by using the milestones (points that do not move) of the division vibration pattern as driving points.324 cm, equivalent to 20 cm, in the lower range2Equipped with a flat woofer.It uses a flat diaphragm sandwiched between aluminum honeycomb and aluminum skin. Four driving points are chosen as the points where the milestones (points that do not move) of the low-order mode of divided vibration are concentrated. It is driven by four armatures directly connected to the voice coil. By this method, divided vibration in the used band is eliminated and the pistnick motion band is expanded.16 cm, equivalent to 4.5 cm, in the high-frequency range2Equipped with a planar type tweeter.The diaphragm has the same structure as the woofer, which sandwiches aluminum honeycomb with aluminum skin. The large voice coil drives the point to cancel the split vibration, so that the split vibration within the audible band is almost completely eliminated.The network section is designed to take advantage of the capabilities of the APM unit. The internal wiring is made of oxygen-free copper wires with excellent transmission characteristics, and several types of capacitors with excellent sound quality are used in parallel. In addition, high-quality air-core coils are used to minimize loss.In addition, it is equipped with level control so that it can be adjusted according to the room.The sound of the enclosure is improved by controlling the vibration of the inner surface and outer periphery of the back plate with fine grooves.In addition, three types of sound absorbing materials are selectively used to control the sound inherent to the sound absorbing material and achieve a natural sound absorbing effect.There was a special speaker stand sold separately."

description: "This is a bookshelf type speaker system announced as a core APM speaker.In the APM speaker, the flat diaphragm eliminates the cavity effect, which is the resonance phenomenon of air that occurs in the conventional megaphone-shaped cone, and prevents the frequency characteristics from being disturbed.In addition, the honeycomb sandwich structure used for the body of aircraft and Shinkansen is used for the diaphragm. This suppresses the generation of split vibration.In addition, by adopting a square shape with a simpler division vibration pattern than the round shape, the division vibration is effectively cancelled, and unnecessary peculiarities are eliminated.424 cm in the lower range2Uses APM type woofer.A flat diaphragm with an aluminum honeycomb sandwiched between aluminum skins is used for the diaphragm. name: SONY
description: "This is an APM3-way speaker system with enhanced perfection of each item such as a tweeter using amorphous diamond, a multi-point drive woofer, and an acoustic launched enclosure.424 cm in the lower range2Uses APM type woofer.The aluminum honeycomb vibration plate is driven by multiple armatures directly connected to the voice coil, and the concept of multi-point drive which effectively cancels the divided vibration is developed, and the divided vibration up to higher mode is canceled by a total of 8 armatures.As a result, we have acquired approximately five times the pistic motion bandwidth of the equivalent cone type woofer, and achieved a flat wide playback bandwidth of up to 4 kHz.In order to take advantage of this drive system, it is equipped with a magnetic circuit with low distortion design such as a T-shaped pole piece with excellent symmetry of magnetic flux and a perforated yoke that reduces back pressure of the vibration plate.In addition, the high-efficiency oxygen-free copper edge-wise voice coil and die-cast frame using an amide bobbin with high heat resistance and high rigidity are used to achieve more faithful reproduction of digital sources.48 cm of double-sided drive system in the middle area2APM type mid-range is adopted.The vibration plate uses three layers of reinforced aluminum skin material based on aluminum. The surface of the reinforced aluminum material with fine cavities inside is treated for vibration control. This increases the synthesis and reduces the internal loss. Both sides of the sweet spot of the material around the vibration plate are driven to improve the rise and stretch of the sound.The magnetic circuit features a T-shaped pole piece, a perforated yoke, and a copper cap to ensure a low-strain design. In addition, it uses the largest class strontium ferrite magnet, oxygen-free copper coated aluminum edgewise, and voice coil.In addition, the lowest resonance frequency is designed to be low by adopting a back chamber.9 cm with an amorphous diamond vibrating plate for the high-frequency range2APM type tweeter has been adopted.Amorphous diamond is a carbon material with physical characteristics very close to diamond, and the sound velocity reaches 18,300m/sec. We have succeeded in vapor deposition of this new material on aluminum skin material, and excellent transient characteristics are obtained by the synergistic effect of high sound velocity, high synthesis, and aluminum honeycomb structure.In addition, the voice coil is made of lightweight and highly efficient copper-coated aluminum edgewise wire. The magnetic circuit is equipped with one of the largest class strontium ferrite magnets, and magnetic fluid with high heat dissipation and damping effects is injected into the voice coil cap.The network section uses carefully selected parts with low distortion, low loss, and audibly examined.For the Woofer coil for which a large current flows, a thick wire with a wire diameter of 1.5 mm is used to prevent deterioration of sound quality due to resistance. In addition, each coil uses an air core structure suitable for each coil and a silicon steel core to suppress distortion and noise turbidity.In addition, two coils for the woofer, the tweeter, and the mid-range are arranged on two boards perpendicular to each other is perpendicular to each other, and the boards are distributed in positions where interference is least.In addition, a large electrolytic capacitor in a highly vibration-proof plastic case and a polyester film capacitor can be selectively used to obtain a clear reproduction sound without any peculiarity.Oxygen-free copper is used for internal wiring materials such as coil wires and capacitor leads.A. R. E. (Acoustic Rolled-Up Enclosure) with R at four corners is adopted in order to avoid diffraction phenomenon of sound wave which is reflected at the corner of the enclosure by sound wave emitted from the speaker.In addition, the APM-66ES has a slant on the upper front surface to reduce diffraction phenomena in the high frequency range.The enclosure is made of high-density particle board made from chips of North American conifer trees. In addition to sufficient plate thickness and reinforcement, narrow grooves are provided inside the back plate to minimize box rumbling and noise and tune it to a natural sound.Finished with wood-grain black finish.Equipped with level control, both mid-range and tweeter can be adjusted from 0 dB to 50 dB.A special speaker stand is available and sold separately.The stand can be bolted securely to the bottom of the enclosure and is at an optimum height for the listener seated.A sound-absorbing sheet is attached to the top of the stand bottom plate to prevent sound reflection."

name: SS-G7A
description: "This speaker system was developed by redesigning the SS-G7, which has been used by more than 10,000 people as a large-floor-type speaker, after four years of aging.A 38 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.CARBOCON is used for the diaphragm. This ensures accurate piston motion up to the upper limit of the operating bandwidth.The magnetic circuit uses a T-shaped pole piece and a current suppressor ring to improve magnetic linearity and reduce distortion. In addition, a large-diameter 100 mm edge-wise voice coil with enhanced strength and efficiency is used.Urethane edge is used for shearing.Mid-range with 10 cm balanced drive mid-rangeIn addition to the adoption of edge-wise voice coil, the edge dump material and impregnation agent were also examined and improved.Equipped with 3.5 cm balanced drive type tweeter.The vibration plate realizes high-speed response by applying ion plating on both sides of the titanium vibration plate and expands the pistic motion band. In addition, the strength and efficiency are improved by adopting the edge-wise voice coil.The Network Division is designed using the know-how obtained from the latest amplifier technology.First of all, the oxygen-free copper wire coil is fixed with SBMC to form a vibration-resistant network, and electrolytic capacitors in plastic cases and polyester film capacitors are used.In addition, mutual interference is eliminated by separating each network board.Oxygen-free copper wires are used for internal wiring to prevent deterioration of sound quality.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.The baffle board is made of double-structured 30 mm thick hard particleboards and the other side is made of 20 mm thick high-density particleboards, making the enclosure strong enough to match the size of the unit. In addition, Sony's original groove processing is applied to the baffle plate and back plate, and reinforcement and sound absorption processing are applied to disperse and reduce unwanted noise.All units of the woofer, mid-range and tweeter are positioned according to the inverse square law of the sound source, so that the position of the sound source as seen by the listener is aligned in both front and rear.The front baffle is an AG board (equatorial grooved board) with innumerable vertical and horizontal grooves. This is a kind of diffuse effect that scatters reflected waves of middle and high sound with relatively short wavelength by the vertical and horizontal grooves. It suppresses the generation of harsh peak feeling and improves directional characteristics.A unit board is used to mount the mid-range and tweeter, ensuring the strength of the baffle plate while bringing the units closer together."

name: SONY
description: "This is the top class speaker system among the G series released by SONY.A plum-in-line method is used to clarify the position of the sound source. In this method, units are arranged in a vertical row in order to align the sound source to the front, back, left and right, and a woofer, which tends to be located in the rear, is placed in the front.In addition, the mid-high and tweeter units are arranged on a single unit board. This makes the units closer to each other and improves vertical directivity.The baffle board with numerous longitudinal and transverse grooves on the surface, which is also a feature of the G series, is called an equatorial grooved board (AG board). It has a diffuse effect that disperses high-energy frequencies. For example, it prevents middle-and-high sound with relatively short wavelengths from being reflected here and from interfering directly with waves to make specific frequencies sharp.In addition, the enclosure is designed to disperse plate vibration by means of internal reinforcement to avoid overlapping of specific frequencies, thus reducing the box rumbling phenomenon.The shape of the cone paper is designed using NASTRAN.A 38 cm cone type woofer with CARBOCON is installed in the low range.The magnetic circuit of this unit weighs as much as 7.8 kg. The magnetic flux density is 10800 gauss by Alnico V magnet. In addition, radial slits are inserted in the pole and yoke of the magnetic circuit to cut off the eddy current near the voice coil to suppress distortion and loss. Many other improvements have been made to reduce the sense of distortion.A 20 cm cone type midbus unit is installed in the middle and low range.This unit uses a magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of up to 10,000 Gauss to drive a large diameter voice coil with a diameter of 75 mm. The structure of the magnetic circuit is similar to that of the Woofer and well reproduces the important band from 300 Hz to 1200 Hz.Equipped with 8 cm balanced drive mid-high unit for middle and high range.This unit is designed so that the driving conditions of the inner and outer sides of the voice coil are equal, so that both expansion of the piston motion area and securing sufficient sound pressure energy are compatible.A magnetic circuit of up to 14,200 gauss is also used.A 3.5 cm balanced drive type tweeter is installed in the high range.The diaphragm is made of 20 Ï‰ m titanium foil molded into a balanced drive shape by an integrated deep drawing method. Moreover, the diaphragm surface is coated with a special high-rigidity material. name: Specifications
description: "As the second generation of the Walkman, this model was designed to be compact and lightweight.The WM-2 is designed to be smaller than the cassette case, which has the minimum capacity to store cassettes. The height is 0.5 mm lower than the cassette case and the depth is thinner than two cassette cases.In addition to reducing the weight of the body, we have achieved a weight of 280g by simplifying the tape travel system and adopting ICs for the internal circuit.In this weight reduction, we are pursuing a weight reduction of up to one screw.By changing the tape insertion method and attaching the reproducing head to the cover side instead of the conventional one, we succeeded in reducing the movement of the head to approximately 1/2 and rationalizing the reproducing mechanism of each tape.The operation system is a one hand control that can be operated with one hand. It is possible to control with one finger by arranging the buttons of the tape running instruction in one place.In addition, it is equipped with an auto shut-off mechanism, and the mechanism automatically stops when all tapes are finished during playback, so there is no danger of battery exhaustion or damage to tapes.Equipped with a 2-position switching type tape selector, you can choose characteristics that take advantage of each performance of metal tape and normal tape.The drive motor uses a BSL coreless motor that boasts high rotational accuracy.This motor has no brush or slot and does not produce uneven torque. Moreover, with the same shape as conventional motors, the power consumption is reduced by half while the torque is increased by two times. In addition, the servo effect of the built-in FG (frequency generator) enables stable rotational accuracy to be maintained.The tape mechanism uses an anti-rolling mechanism.In this system, two reversing flywheels are built in, and the flywheels cancel each other's vibration to prevent sound fluctuation even if an external shock causes a disturbance of the tape.The WM-2 can operate with two AA batteries, allowing for approximately nine hours of continuous playback.In addition, two D batteries can be used in the attached battery case for approximately 60 hours of continuous playback. When both batteries are used together, a maximum of approximately 69 hours of continuous playback is possible.Equipped with 2 types of headphone jacks, 2 people can enjoy tape sound at the same time.Equipped with an LED indicator, you can confirm that the Walkman is operating during playback, fast forwarding, and rewind.When the battery is exhausted and the voltage decreases, the light turns off at approximately 1.5 v.It is compatible with 3 power systems and can be used indoors or in a car by using not only dry batteries but also AC adapter and car battery cord sold separately.Carrying case with shoulder belt is included.Headphone MDR-4L1S is included.This headphone is a 28g lightweight type, and a wide playback band is realized by a powerful magnetic circuit and a vibration film using a polymer film.During a conversation, you can press the Walkman button in the middle of the headphone cord, and the built-in resistance attenuator reduces the volume of the tape.

V. L. name: SONY
description: "This metal tape-compatible cassette deck was developed not only for basic performance but also for overall perfection in sound quality and operability.A microcomputer has been installed in the operation section of the cassette deck. Since the timing of each operation of the mechanism section is controlled in time series, the operation is completely stopped before moving to the next operation. Therefore, no excessive force is applied to the tape in the cassette half, preventing the tape from stretching. Furthermore, the complicated transmission mechanism is simplified due to the electromagnetic solenoid drive, and reliability is improved.In these operations, first, the motor rotates in accordance with each operation mode, and the Hall element detects pulses corresponding to the number of rotations of the magnet (rotor). This is counted by the microcomputer, processed logically and digitally, and the mechanism is operated by driving the trigger plunger.A 4-bit 42-pin LSI (CPU) is used for this operation control unit, making it compact with a discrete type combined with transistors, and realizing a highly reliable and responsive logic circuit.It is a direct change operation in which you can move directly to the next operation without pressing the stop button during operation.In addition, the Send button, Record button, and Pause button lights up when each function is active, so you can easily check their operation.The head uses an S & F head that combines the high frequency characteristics of ferrite with the high saturation magnetic flux density of Sendust alloy.The erasing head uses a magnetic focus 4-Gap erasing head with a magnetic focusing structure that uses a magnetic lens to apply strong magnetic flux to the tape.BSL (brush and slot-less) motor is used.This motor eliminates the cogging by the slot (groove) for forming the magnetic pole in order to solve the torque unevenness problem of the conventional DC motor from the structure, and achieves quiet and smooth rotation by the simple structure with no brush.In the mechanism section, a BSL green motor for constant speed running (FWD) and a high-torque motor for quick winding (FF/REW) are exclusively used, and the structure is simple without complicated transmission structure. This improves reliability, reduces rotational loss, and achieves stable running by combining with frequency servo system.To further improve the reliability of this 2-motor mechanism, each operation is driven by an electromagnetic solenoid, and the lock mechanism of the operation button and transmission mechanism such as idler are simplified to improve the reliability.As a noise reduction system, Dolby NR is installed.The Dolby IC has a built-in line amplifier and recording equalizer amplifier. The number of elements is equivalent to 160. Thus, complicated circuit routing can be avoided and sound quality is improved. In addition, since the recording / re-switching switch can be omitted, the reliability of the amplifier section is improved.In order to eliminate uneven torque on the reel base, which causes disturbances in tape running, we have adopted a non-contact magnet clutch that transmits torque to the reel base by magnetic force. This eliminates mechanical friction and ensures stable torque while improving the reliability of the mechanism.In order to prevent malfunction of the Dolby NR circuit with 19 kHz pilot signal during FM air check, an MPX filter switch is mounted to cut the pilot signal.The amplifier section uses ¥2 power supply system, and the S & F head and amplifier section are directly coupled to achieve low distortion and excellent high-frequency characteristics.Equipped with Rec Mute function with auto space, it cuts the recording source, creates optimum space between songs, and automatically switches to a paused state.If you want to make a blank for less than 4 seconds, press the pause button to release it. If you want to make a blank for more than 4 seconds, press and hold the button to make a blank for only that time, and release your finger to make a temporary stop.Equipped with autoplay / memory play function.It is equipped with a follow-up recording function. When you want to play a part of the tape and record after that, you can press the feed (FWD) button and the record (REC) button at the same time to immediately enter the recording state.The VU meter is equipped with a peak level indicator that displays in five levels (-8/-3/0 / + 2 / + 4 dB) to respond to a pulsed signal that cannot be indicated by the VU meter. In particular, + 4 dB corresponds to + 8 VU of the VU meter, so you can set the recording level taking advantage of the saturation level of the metal tape.It is equipped with twin VU meter that follows in proportion to volume feeling with little indication error.Equipped with a microphone / line input change-over switch that greatly improves the SN ratio at line input.Equipped with a 4-step tape selector with independent bias / equalizer.The equalizer has four levels : Type-I (normal), Type-II (for CrO2 and JHF cassettes), Type-III (for Fe-Cr and DUAD cassettes), and Type-IV (metal). The bias has four levels : norma (I/III), low / high (II), and metal (IV).Built-in see-through lamp that can check the remaining amount of the tape.Uses an auto shut-off mechanism that does not damage the mechanism or tape.By using the timer (sold separately), you can record a continuous absence or play an alarm clock.Remote control unit sold separately allows operation from a remote location."

name: SONY
description: "This metal tape-compatible cassette deck was developed not only for basic performance but also for overall perfection in sound quality and operability.It has almost the same configuration as the TC-K55 with an additional RMS, and an LED peak program meter in place of the VU meter and peak indicator.A microcomputer has been installed in the operation section of the cassette deck. Since the timing of each operation of the mechanism section is controlled in time series, the operation is completely stopped before moving to the next operation. Therefore, no excessive force is applied to the tape in the cassette half, preventing the tape from stretching. Furthermore, the complicated transmission mechanism is simplified due to the electromagnetic solenoid drive, and reliability is improved.In these operations, first, the motor rotates in accordance with each operation mode, and the Hall element detects pulses corresponding to the number of rotations of the magnet (rotor). This is counted by the microcomputer, processed logically and digitally, and the mechanism is operated by driving the trigger plunger.A 4-bit 42-pin LSI (CPU) is used for this operation control unit, making it compact with a discrete type combined with transistors, and realizing a highly reliable and responsive logic circuit.It is a direct change operation in which you can move directly to the next operation without pressing the stop button during operation.In addition, the Send button, Record button, and Pause button lights up when each function is active, so you can easily check their operation.The head uses an S & F head that combines the high frequency characteristics of ferrite with the high saturation magnetic flux density of Sendust alloy.The erasing head uses a magnetic focus 4-Gap erasing head with a magnetic focusing structure that uses a magnetic lens to apply strong magnetic flux to the tape.BSL (brush and slot-less) motor is used.This motor eliminates the cogging by the slot (groove) for forming the magnetic pole in order to solve the torque unevenness problem of the conventional DC motor from the structure, and achieves quiet and smooth rotation by the simple structure with no brush.In the mechanism section, a BSL green motor for constant speed running (FWD) and a high-torque motor for quick winding (FF/REW) are exclusively used, and the structure is simple without complicated transmission structure. This improves reliability, reduces rotational loss, and achieves stable running by combining with frequency servo system.To further improve the reliability of this 2-motor mechanism, each operation is driven by an electromagnetic solenoid, and the lock mechanism of the operation button and transmission mechanism such as idler are simplified to improve the reliability.As a noise reduction system, Dolby NR is installed.The Dolby IC has a built-in line amplifier and recording equalizer amplifier. The number of elements is equivalent to 160. Thus, complicated circuit routing can be avoided and sound quality is improved. In addition, since the recording / re-switching switch can be omitted, the reliability of the amplifier section is improved.In order to eliminate uneven torque on the reel base, which causes disturbances in tape running, we have adopted a non-contact magnet clutch that transmits torque to the reel base by magnetic force. This eliminates mechanical friction and ensures stable torque while improving the reliability of the mechanism.In order to prevent malfunction of the Dolby NR circuit with 19 kHz pilot signal during FM air check, an MPX filter switch is mounted to cut the pilot signal.The amplifier section uses ¥2 power supply system, and the S & F head and amplifier section are directly coupled to achieve low distortion and excellent high-frequency characteristics.Equipped with Rec Mute function with auto space, it cuts the recording source, creates optimum space between songs, and automatically switches to a paused state.If you want to make a blank for less than 4 seconds, press the pause button to release it. If you want to make a blank for more than 4 seconds, press and hold the button to make a blank for only that time, and release your finger to make a temporary stop.Equipped with autoplay / memory play function.It is equipped with a follow-up recording function. When you want to play a part of the tape and record after that, you can press the feed (FWD) button and the record (REC) button at the same time to immediately enter the recording state.The microphone input volume and the line input volume are dedicated respectively and the input circuit is separated so that the line input does not pass through the microphone amplifier and the dynamic range of the line input is not impaired.The built-in recording master volume makes it easy to fade out and fade in.It is equipped with an LED peak program meter that can quickly respond to even a pulsed sound that cannot be followed by a VU meter, and enables proper recording level setting with less distortion.This meter uses a double indication system that simultaneously displays the peak level that changes every moment and the peak held level, making it easy to obtain the optimum recording level.In addition, the element color is displayed using yellow and red LEDs based on 0 dB.Equipped with an RMS (Random Memory Music Sensor) that plays 1 to 15 songs at random using a dedicated microcomputer.This function uses Rec Mute to create an appropriate space between songs (an unrecorded portion of more than four seconds) when recording. This unrecorded portion is then detected by the microcomputer and played back as it is stored.In addition, you can store up to 16 consecutive songs, so you can play the same song in succession.Equipped with a 4-step tape selector with independent bias / equalizer.The equalizer has four levels : Type-I (normal), Type-II (for CrO2 and JHF cassettes), Type-III (for Fe-Cr and DUAD cassettes), and Type-IV (metal). The bias has four levels : norma (I/III), low / high (II), and metal (IV).Built-in see-through lamp that can check the remaining amount of the tape.Uses an auto shut-off mechanism that does not damage the mechanism or tape.By using the timer (sold separately), you can record a continuous absence or play an alarm clock.Remote control unit sold separately allows operation from a remote location."

name: TC-K555ES

This head is structurally independent but occupies the same space as a combination head, enabling uniform head touch and highly accurate azimuth adjustment.Closed-loop dual capstan system is adopted for the mechanism part.The tape is held between two pairs of capstan and pinch rollers positioned at the center of the head to stabilize the movement of the tape in the vicinity of the head. The vibration of the tape transmitted from the reel and improves wow and flutter characteristics. The distance for suppressing the tape is shortened to suppress the vibration of the tape and eliminate modulation. By utilizing the tape tension between the two capstan, a stable head touch can be obtained at all times. In addition, the specification characteristics are improved and the modulation noise harmful to the hearing sense is greatly reduced.The capstan drive motor uses a linear BSL motor with a simple structure that eliminates the slot and brush that cause uneven torque.In addition, a high-torque DC motor is independently used for the reel and the transmission structure is eliminated to improve the reliability of the mechanism.Equipped with Dolby NF C type that reduces hissing.Compared to the conventional B-type, it achieves a noise reduction effect of 20 dB, which is approximately three times higher in the high frequency band of 5 kHz, and reduces the hissing to 1/10 of that in the OFF state.It also has a Dolby B type and can be used for recorded tapes.The amplifier section uses a twin mono configuration for both right and left of the recording / playback flat amplifier to suppress mutual interference, and construction along the signal flow to suppress interference at the front and rear stages. name: TC-K666ES
description: "The stereo cassette deck was announced as the core machine of the ES series which shows the new achievement of the cassette deck with 3 motors, independent 3 heads, thorough vibration proof design, etc.It uses a 3-head configuration with Sony's proprietary independently suspended laser amorphous recording and playback heads.The core of the head uses an amorphous magnetic alloy that provides high magnetic flux density and excellent magnetic linearity in a non-crystalline state without the characteristic crystal structure. Since the L/Rch including the amplifier circuit is designed to be symmetrical, the wiring pattern of peripheral parts is also symmetrical, and the characteristic difference between channels can be reduced.In the amplifier section, all stages of the recording / playback flat amplifier are L/R twin-mono to suppress mutual interference. description: "This cassette deck was developed using the design know-how of the ESG series.By installing a new mechanism, unpleasant mechanical sounds are suppressed and quick operation is realized.It uses a closed-loop dual capstan system, in which the tape is held between two capstan sets centered on the head and pinch rollers, and tape travel is stabilized. This reduces distortion due to capacitive reactances and reduces loss in the mid-range and high-range.Equipped with the Dolby HX-PRO, the effective bias amount is controlled to the optimum value in 1/1000 second increments to prevent over-bias in the high-frequency range and improve linearity in the high-frequency range. name: SONY
description: "This is an L-cassette deck with improved usability by making maximum use of the auto mechanism.Equipped with an automatic tape selector, the optimum bias value and equalizer are set automatically by the combination of the micro switch built into the compartment and the detection hole provided at the bottom of the cassette shell, and the indicator lamp lights up.Automatic Dolby NR detection is possible.When recording Dolby NR, it is automatically judged by folding the tab at the bottom of the shell of the L Cassette, and recording and playback are performed with Dolby NR On.It is equipped with an MPX filter switch that cuts unnecessary pilot signal and subcarrier signal during air check to prevent malfunction of Dolby NR.Rec-Mute can be performed by operating the lever.It adopts a logical control system using a dedicated circuit and electromagnetic solenoid, and the operation lever can be operated with soft touch.Continuous recording is possible by using the separately sold program timer.The head uses a solid-core all-ferrite F & F head that uses a single non-layered ferrite plate not only for the core part but also for the guard part. As a result, the phase and frequency characteristics are improved with less possibility of offset or gap deviation.We have also improved the S / N ratio, frequency characteristics, and distortion factor by adopting a direct coupling method that directly connects the F & F head and the reproducing amplifier using FET.The motor is equipped with a frequency servo motor with FG.Servocontrol is performed by directly connecting an FG (frequency-generator) to the rotating shaft of the motor and detecting the rotational speed deviation based on the generated frequency change. This structure makes it less susceptible to electrical fluctuations in the circuit. Even if the voltage fluctuates due to temperature rises, the oscillation frequency hardly changes and the rotational speed remains stable.Equipped with a tension regulator that suppresses speed deviation when the tape is running.It is equipped with a scrape filter to suppress modulation noise.Follow-up recording is possible.Equipped with a memory stop mechanism.Equipped with an input selector.Equipped with photoelectric detection type auto shut-off mechanism.Equipped with safety lock mechanism.Equipped with a soft eject mechanism."

description: "L Cassette Recorder ""L Cassette Denske DD"" which can use L Cassette raw records.The Capstan adopts a direct drive system using a BSL (brush and slotless) motor, which has been used in Sony's DD players, and incorporates a magnesium disk servo with high anti-rolling effect.In principle, the BSL motor does not have cogging (torque unevenness), and combined with an excellent servomechanism, it realizes low wow and flutter.A dedicated DC motor is used for quick winding, and a 2-motor configuration forms a mechanism that is not unreasonable.In order to prevent complications during use, the LCassette tape has three unified standards, Type-I, II and III. description: "Equipped with a unilinear converter system, this full-size CD player achieves high sound quality.The Unilinear converter system synchronizes the circuits of the D/A converter, digital filter and EFM de-modulator to a single master clock for all digital signal processing, which in principle prevents beat generation in the audio band due to interference of two or more clocks.It also incorporates a newly developed high-precision digital filter to improve the distortion and phase characteristics.The optical pick-up cap is made of a material that is less susceptible to unwanted vibration. name: SONY
description: "A CD player with the technology used in the ES series.Digital sync ICs are used to reduce jitter that occurs when digital signals are transmitted.The pit information read from the disk is converted into a digital signal by a signal processing LSI and sent to a digital filter and a D/A converter. During this time period, jitter occurs in the digital signal. The original information of a digital signal is a sequence of encoded numerical values that is not affected by the transmission system, but when it is transmitted as an electrical signal, it is a sequence of pulse signals. For this reason, digital signals that have passed through many circuits fluctuate irregularly, with the pulse width being longer or shorter than it should be. As a result, the clock has jitter, and the time-axis accuracy of the signal deteriorates during D/A conversion.In the digital sync IC, the timing of the digital signal generated by the signal processing LSI is adjusted to the accuracy of the master clock immediately before the D/A converter. The master clock that determines the time axis accuracy of the signal is directly connected to the D/A converter. By adjusting the timing to the accuracy of the clean master clock that does not include jitter, the digital signal is adjusted again and output to the D/A converter. Since the effect of jitter does not affect the D/A converter and beyond, D/A conversion with accurate phase and faithful D/A conversion is possible.The digital filter is equipped with CXD 1244 which is an 8 fs 45-bit noise shaping digital filter.This digital filter performs 8 times oversampling and resamples the signal from 44.1 kHz to 352.8 kHz (8 times the sampling frequency) to increase the distance between the audio signal and the unwanted high-frequency components. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics in the analog portion after D/A conversion, greatly improving the group delay characteristics.The CXD 1244 achieves the in-band ripple characteristics of ¥0.00001 dB and the echo level of -124dB or less due to its 45-bit high-order computing capability.The CXD 1244 is capable of performing extremely high-precision operations with a 45-bit operation bit length. However, since the D/A converter can have only a limited number of bits, round-off errors occur and remain as quantization noise. To solve this problem, we have adopted a high-resolution D/A converter with excellent characteristics and introduced a noise-shaping method, which is incorporated into the CXD 1244.Noise shaping takes advantage of an over-sampling time interval to incorporate low-order bit information that is normally lost by round-off errors into high-order data.Equipped with digital de-emphasis function.In digital de-emphasis, the de-emphasis process conventionally composed of analog circuits is digitally processed inside the digital filter, eliminating sound quality degradation caused by parts and circuits, and achieving ideal gain and phase characteristics.The D/A converter IC is equipped with a high-precision linear D/A converter.This is a high-speed operation type that corresponds to the data output speed of the 8 fs digital filter and enables more advanced D/A conversion, which improves linearity for small level signals.In addition, this D/A converter is a single-chip IC with high stability of conversion operation and realizes linear operation from the most significant bit to the least significant bit. Therefore, in principle, there is no nonlinear element in input / output characteristics. Therefore, additional circuits such as gain switching are unnecessary, and the analog circuit section is simplified.In addition, by making the left and right channels independent of each other, the phase shift between the channels is eliminated.The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III.The SS Servo III, noise components that cause adverse effects are removed through a low-pass filter, and the influence on the audio circuit is reduced by sending a smooth servo current to the servo circuit. Moreover, unnecessary vibration of the optical system mechanism is also suppressed.It is equipped with a custom edit function that combines three functions : time edit, program edit, and time fade.With Time Edit, you enter the time for one side of the tape and press the Edit button to program the music to be played in order from the first song. When you encounter a time-over song, the program automatically selects the longest song within the time range. Press the Edit button once to continue the program for the A side, and press the Edit button again to continue the program for the B side. The pause is automatically inserted between the A side and the B side.In program edit, you program the songs you want to put on the A side of the tape in the order you like, then press the pause button and continue to program the B side.With the Time Fade function, if you set the time beforehand, the FOMA terminal automatically fades out approximately five seconds before the time and enters a pause state.The manual fader function allows manual operation to fade in / out.With this function, the fade operation takes approximately 5 seconds from where the button is pressed.It includes custom file functionality with three functions : disk memory, custom index, and program bank.With Disk Memo, when you insert a disc, a message you enter appears on the display, followed by the number of songs and the total duration of performance. You can make a note of up to 10 characters per disc. You can use 46 letters, numbers, and special symbols.The custom index allows you to set an index of up to 10 points at any location on a single disk, even if no index information is recorded on the disk itself. The index set includes a rehearsal function that allows fine tuning in steps of approximately ¥0.15 seconds.In the Program Bank, you can directly record a program set with the Program Performance function that can play up to 20 songs continuously. You can call up the program with the File Recall button, or you can directly bank the contents of a program set with Custom Edit.It is equipped with a file recall function that allows you to check what files have been stored so far without having to insert a disk.This allows you to check without having to insert a disk, and also to erase the file contents on the spot.It is equipped with delete shuffle function for 99 songs.Equipped with a multi-mode timer function, you can start from your favorite music, shuffle play and repeat.By combining the custom index function, it is also possible to play the alarm clock with any phrase.Two types of analog output terminal are mounted : fixed and variable.The headphone port is equipped with a headphone port with a lineout linked volume that flashes when the remote control is operated.Equipped with an optical digital output.It is equipped with a program performance function of up to 20 songs, 6-mode repeat function of 1 song / whole song / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / custom index, and auto space function.Equipped with 2-speed Music Search that enables fast forward / fast backward while listening to music.Slow mode can only be operated from the remote control.Comes with a 20-key wireless remote control with volume control."

name: SONY
description: "A CD player equipped with a newly developed pulse 4D/A converter as well as custom edit and file functions.The D/A converter consists of a high-density linear converter system, a 45-bit noise-shaping digital filter and a pulse D/A converter.The Pulse D/A converter consists of a current source and an electronic switch. It expresses music waveform by switching two values of 0 and 1 at high speed. By this, the amplitude level is always constant and changes only in the time axis direction. The PLM (Pulse Length Modulation) wave is output. By passing it through a low-pass filter, unwanted high-frequency noise outside the audio band is removed and music waveform is obtained.To reduce quantization noise in the audible band up to 20 kHz, the pulse D/A converter is equipped with a multi-stage noise shaping operation that employs 64 times oversampling and the Sony Extended Noise Shaping method. Oversampling reduces quantization noise in the audible band by increasing the sampling frequency. Noise shaping reduces quantization noise in the audible band by feeding back the requantization error to the input side when the number of bits is reduced. These technologies ensure a high dynamic range.The pulse D/A converter operates at 45 mega pulses per second, and it completely eliminates differential non-linear distortion, glitch, and 0 cross distortion, which were difficult with conventional methods.The CDP-991 uses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. A single pulse D/A converter provides a 4D/A output that outputs positive-phase and negative-phase LR signals.To take advantage of the pulse D/A converter, the high-density linear converter system is equipped with a 45-bit noise-shaping digital filter in the front stage.This circuit achieves a high dynamic range by performing a highly accurate oversampling operation and a first order noise-shaping operation on the operation result.A direct digital sink is included to eliminate jittering issues.In this system, the master clock is formed on the same chip as the pulse D/A converter, and jitter is eliminated in principle by eliminating jitter immediately before the electronic switch, which is the final stage of the pulse D/A converter.The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III.In the S Servo III, the high-frequency noise component of the servo current is removed with a low-pass filter to supply a smooth servo current, which stabilizes the power supply from the power supply and prevents adverse effects on sound quality.A digital CLV servo is installed in the drive system servo circuit that controls disk rotation.The digital CLV servo detects the rotation of the spindle motor and controls it with 10-bit resolution to maintain an accurate linear velocity regardless of the disk's inner or outer circumference. It also detects the difference in inertial mass between the 12 cm CD and 8 cm CD disks to drive more appropriately.Low noise and high stability are achieved by incorporating an RF amplifier in the pickup section.The digital signal processing LSI uses the fourth generation LSI for the Sony CD player. Previously external RAM has been upgraded to a capacity of 32 kbit and built into the digital signal processing LSI. The precision of the signal processing capability is further enhanced by adopting the strict 6-fold error correction method.Aluminum panel is used for the front panel.

description: "A CD player using a magazine system.It uses a magazine system that can store up to 10 disks.This allows you to play one by one, play ten in a row, or play a program through ten.The D/A converter consists of a high-density linear converter system, a 45-bit noise-shaping digital filter and a pulse D/A converter.The CDP-C910 uses a single-mode pulse D/A converter. The disc is set by sliding the lid of the top panel by hand and fixed with a stabilizer.In addition, the mechanism has a unique floating structure inside, and it is mounted directly on the chassis to obtain simplicity and stable drive performance.The servo circuit uses a high-precision digital servo, and by adjusting the servo amount of the optical pickup for each disc being played, servocontrol that more accurately reflects the disc condition is possible.The digital filter is equipped with a newly developed variable (V. C.) digital filter.The cut-off characteristics and phase characteristics of digital filters can be set by equations, and sound quality can be changed by changing these characteristics. Therefore, we have registered multiple equations for newly developed digital filter ICs so that you can select your favorite position according to your audio equipment, room environment, and music.In addition to the standard position with sharp roll-off characteristics, the CDP-X3000 is equipped with No. 1, 2 and 3 with slow roll-off characteristics. You can choose from a total of four positions.The Standard and Spline variable digital filters use full feed-forward digital filters.This digital filter employs a three step coupling of a double-type digital filter, which first generates complementary data at the midpoint between the data obtained from the disk and the data, and then uses the resulting data to create the next complementary data. Conventional digital filters use only the high-order bits by rounding the low-order bits of the calculation results obtained here, but this rounding error causes requantization noise.The full-feed-forward digital filter realizes an oversampling operation that also reflects low-bit data by performing a full-feed forward (FF) operation that combines the low-bit data with the result of the next stage operation. This eliminates almost all requantization noise in the audible band, greatly improving the quality of low-level signals.A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.In this method, a stable and clean current source is prepared, and the current pulse is generated by switching using the output of the pulse generator. The position and diameter of the hole are determined through repeated trial production and trial listening. This is particularly effective in attenuating mid - and high-frequency vibration components that affect audibility.An R core transformer is used for the power supply.In the R-core transformer, magnetic flux leakage and vibration are greatly reduced by making the iron core a circular doughnut type with no breaks.Two digital output systems are mounted : optical and coaxial.The digital output can be turned ON/OFF, and turning it OFF reduces the influence on the analog output.Equipped with a custom edit function, you can control functions such as peak search, program edit, manual fader and variable fade.It is equipped with functions such as shuffle play, delete shuffle, 5-mode repeat and index search.Wireless remote control is included."

name: SONY
description: "A CD player based on CDP-502ES with added digital output and insulator.The digital audio interface outputs enable transmission over a single digital cable along with signals such as emphasis ON/OFF, sub-code, and synchronization signals applying Phase Double Mark (biphasemark) modulation based on the standard format of the CD-standard.This completely separates the CD's rotating machinery from the audio circuit, making the delicate audio circuit less susceptible to mechanical vibration of the rotating machinery and to noise from digital and servo circuits.In addition, a pin jack is used for the output terminal, and an isolation pulse transformer is used for the signal output part with a sealed electromagnetic shield structure to separate the ground line.The Unilinear converter system is used in the digital section to perform digital signal processing by fully synchronizing circuits such as D/A converters, digital filters, and EFM de-modulators with a single master clock. This eliminates in principle beat generation due to interference between two or more clocks.In addition, the EFM de-modulator, which used to be three chips, has been integrated into one chip, resulting in a simpler structure.The CDP 552 esd is equipped with a digital filter that oversamples the digital signal before D/A conversion to increase the frequency band distance between the unwanted component and the music signal.Furthermore, since the ripple characteristic in the audio band is less than 0.01 dB and the attenuation in the stopband is 80 dB, the attenuation characteristic of the low-pass filter after D/A conversion can be made smooth and good phase characteristics can be obtained.In order to realize simple and straight transmission, the rotary system, digital circuit, and analog circuit are completely separated. In addition, the position of the mounting screw is also examined repeatedly, and the internal layout is designed with structural rigidity in mind.As a result, resonance, which affects sound quality, is suppressed in various details.In addition, the audio circuit is a twin-mono configuration with Lch and Rch separation by bus bar, and a 7th-order GIC (Generalized Impedance Converter) low-pass filter is adopted, in which the music signal passes only through the resistance of the series arm of the filter.In the power supply section, a large 35 VA transformer with more than double allowance in actual use is used. The power transformer consists of an OFC winding, an OFC lead wire, and a Z-material core. In addition, the power transformer is separated into three windings for analog circuits, digital & servo, and display to reduce mutual interference.The rectifier diode also uses an ultrafast recovery diode with a recovery time of 35 nsec and a rating of 10A with a margin.In addition, the analog power supply circuit is composed of a discrete high-speed stabilized power supply, and a large electrolytic capacitor using ceramic powder and a tantalum capacitor with excellent high-frequency characteristics for bypassing between the power supply and the earth ground are used to enhance the supply capability and response of the power supply section for signals.We put in a lot of carefully selected parts.Starting with a copper-plated chassis that greatly eliminates magnetic distortion, the amplifier section is equipped with a high-quality operational amplifier. In addition, a mold-type non-inductive styrene capacitor is used for the integration circuit, a composite capacitor with non-inductive electrodes made of polystyrene and polypropylene derivatives for the emphasis time constant, and an LC (linear crystal) -OFC is used for the wires for audio signals. The crystals of Type 1 oxygen-free copper (purity of 99.995% or more) are enlarged and the number of crystal boundaries is reduced to reduce sound quality degradation due to capacitive reactances.In addition, as for the resistance, we use many kinds of metal film resistance with a tolerance of 1% or less by applying non-magnetic coating to the OFC lead wire of the copper cap, and also use the line-out volume with carefully examined terminal material.It uses a linear motor tracking mechanism that integrates a linear motor and an optical block, which is also used for professionals. It enables high-speed access with a selection time of approximately one second from the first song on the disc to the start of the last song.In addition, there is almost no mechanical noise and reliability and durability are greatly improved by the integrated structure of drive type and optical system without transmission mechanism such as gear.In addition, the entire mechanical block has a floating structure to suppress external vibration.Four high-rigidity large insulators are included to ensure vibration prevention.Equipped with a music calendar that directly displays the track number of up to 20 songs on the disc.It is equipped with RMS (Random Music Sensor) function of up to 20 songs which can be added or changed even while playing.Equipped with functions such as one touch direct selection and shuffle play with 20 keys, repeat between one song / all songs / A and B parts, AM (Automatic Music Sensor) function that allows you to easily find the beginning of a song you want to listen to, music search function that allows you to fast forward / rewind while listening to a song, and index search function.It employs a push-loading linear skating system that closes even when the disk table is pushed, further increasing the operating speed.It is also equipped with an auto-space play function that automatically sets the interval between songs to 3 seconds during program performance and shuffle play, and an auto-delay function that creates a 2-second blank before the start of performance when directly selecting channels.Equipped with two output terminals, variable and fixed.Equipped with a timer standby switch and an accessory terminal designed to improve the system.Wireless remote controller RM-D502 is included."

name: SONY
description: "ES series CD player.The digital filter uses a 96th order 2 x oversampling FIR type digital filter to improve the group delay characteristics and waveform reproducibility.The analog filter is a 5th-order active analog filter.The D/A converter is equipped with a D/A converter for the left and right channels independently. This reduces the phase difference between the two channels to 0, improving the sound spread in each direction of vertical, horizontal, and depth.The D/A converter uses a high-speed 16-bit type.The servo circuit uses S servo, a predictive control method.When a newly developed RFIC detects the size of a fault on the disk, the S servo uses a microcomputer to predict the periodicity of the fault by high-speed calculation and controls the servo amount appropriately. The prediction accuracy is as high as 8,000 times per second, and the accuracy is constant regardless of the inner and outer circumference of the disk at different rotational speeds. This greatly improves the tracing capability and minimizes disturbance of servo current.Newly developed linear motor drive optical mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.In the base of this mechanism, a cemented base unit is used, which is made by composite molding of special ceramic containing powder with metals. It has excellent characteristics that it itself does not vibrate easily and that even if it vibrates, it quickly attenuates.Combined with the overall floating structure, the mechanism is less susceptible to vibration.It uses a third generation LSI with higher integration and improves reliability by simplifying peripheral circuits.In addition, this LSI makes up a high-precision unilinear converter system, and by fully synchronizing the digital circuit after the digital filter with one master clock, beat generation is suppressed to 0 in principle.Vibration is reduced by using a large insulator and a highly rigid chassis.An audio dedicated carbon resistor is used for the analog circuit.We are also improving sound quality by using OFC power cords with polarity indication, gold-plated output terminals, non-magnetic OFC heat sinks, and copper screws.The power supply section uses a large-capacity power transformer with digital / analog independent power supply circuit.Equipped with color concentrated display with music calendar.Equipped with a shuffle play function.Equipped with 5-mode repeat function of 1 track / all tracks / A-B / program / shuffle.Equipped with a timer switch to which an external timer can be connected for off / normal play / shuffle play.Equipped with Music Search, which enables fast forward / fast reverse while listening to the sound.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.It is equipped with an auto space function that takes a space of 3 seconds between songs.Equipped with an index search.It is equipped with synchronized terminals and subcode terminals that can be easily connected to Sony decks.Wireless remote control is included."

name: SONY
description: "A CD player developed by inheriting the design policy of CDP-555ESD.The digital filter uses a 4 x oversampling digital filter.Before the D/A conversion, this digital filter over-samples the digital signal to a sampling frequency of 176.4 kHz, which is four times the sampling frequency, to eliminate the frequency lower limit of unwanted components from 24.1 kHz to 156.4 kHz. This makes it possible to make the attenuation characteristics of the low-pass filter after the D/A conversion extremely smooth, significantly improve the group delay characteristics, and improve waveform reproducibility. In addition, the filter has a simple structure with fewer stages and fewer elements, so the deterioration of sound quality due to components can be minimized.It is equipped with a unilinear converter system using 3rd generation LSI newly developed exclusively for CDs.This is a digital signal processing system in which a D/A converter, digital filter, and EFM demodulator are completely synchronized with a single master clock. In principle, this system eliminates beat generation due to clock interference.In addition, the third generation LSI, which reduces the number of peripheral parts by half by increasing the degree of integration, is used in the LSI group constituting this system, contributing to the improvement of accuracy and reliability of digital systems as well as the reduction of power consumption.Equipped with a digital processing soft muting function.With this function, clicking noise is prevented by muting instantaneously at the time of performance stop or pose operation. This processing is done by digital circuit to prevent sound quality degradation.The D/A converter has an IC for the D/A converter with excellent linearity for the left and right channels independently. This eliminates the phase difference between the channels and ensures excellent sound localization.The newly developed IC is a high-speed type that corresponds to the signal processing speed of the digital filter. It reduces the 0 cross distortion at the minute signal level and strictly eliminates the jitter component from the converter output. This eliminates not only the L/R switching circuit but also the sample-and-hold circuit, which was indispensable in the past, and makes the audio circuit extremely simple.The low-pass filter uses a third active filter that reduces sound quality degradation, and the all-stage L/R twin-mono configuration eliminates channel interference.The parts used have been carefully examined for sound quality.In addition to high-sound operational amplifiers, copper-heat sinks, and screws, high-sound condensers, gold-plated terminals, and oxygen-free copper power cords with polarity display are used.The power supply circuit uses 9 independent stabilized power supplies.In addition to separating the digital and analog circuits, the power supply for the digital filter and the D/A converter has been dedicated, and the display and other devices have been separated Route 3 to eliminate voltage drops caused by disturbance of the servo power supply and interference with analog circuits such as harmonics of the digital signal.In addition, the capacitors used in power transformers and rectifier circuits are large and have a large capacity that far exceeds the required capacity.The base unit, which is the base of the optical system mechanism, uses a black cemented base unit.This is a composite molding of metal and special resin containing ceramic powder with extremely high internal loss. The resonance sharpness is greatly reduced and the rigidity is also increased to completely suppress the generation of vibration. The entire base unit has a floating structure to block the transmission of vibration from the outside.In addition, the chucking arm that secures the disk to the spindle has a double structure of resin and metal, and aerodynamic measures are also taken to prevent surface wobbling when the disk rotates.The chassis consists of an external chassis and an internal chassis to ensure high strength and rigidity.In addition, the mechanical block part, digital, analog part and control system are separately arranged to eliminate interference and resonance of each part as much as possible. In addition, a special large insulator made of non-resilient rubber and resin is used for the leg part to eliminate vibration transmission from the outside.The servo circuit is equipped with S servo, a newly developed predictive control method.The operating principle of S servo is that when a newly developed RFIC detects signal dropouts caused by scratches or dirt, a microcomputer calculates from the disk rotation cycle to predict when the next dropout will occur, and controls the servo amount of both tracking and focus servo circuits just before the dropout occurs to minimize the occurrence of errors.The predicted time accuracy of the S servo is as high as 1/8,000 second. In addition, it is compatible with CLV (constant linear velocity) and maintains this accuracy at any position inside or around the disk. This improves the tracing capability compared to the conventional method in which the servo amount is controlled after the drop-out occurs. In addition, since the disturbance of the servo current is greatly reduced, the influence on the analog system generated through the power supply is also reduced.High-speed linear motor tracking mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.In this mechanism, a linear motor is integrated into the optical block, enabling high-speed access with less than one second in the selection time from the first song to the start of the final song. In addition, reliability and durability are greatly improved because there is no transmission mechanism such as gears.A latched digital output is used for the digital output section.In addition to the use of an isolation pulse transformer, the analog output is cut during digital output and the digital output is cut during analog output to prevent mutual interference.The output terminal of CDP 333 esd is designed to output subcode information as well.Equipped with a centralized display, you can check the time and performance information in various ways.In addition, it is equipped with Sony original music calendar, and the track number of the recorded music can be directly displayed up to 20 songs.One touch direct music selection with 20 keys is possible.It is equipped with an RMS function that can program up to 20 songs. This RMS function can add or change programs while playing.Equipped with 5-mode repeat function of 1 track / ALL/A-B (between parts) / program / shuffle.In 4 modes except A-B, the repeat count can be specified up to 9 times.Features such as shuffle play, index search, AMS (, AMS (automatic music sensor) and music search.Equipped with an auto-pause function that automatically enters a pause state at the end of each song.Equipped with an auto space function that automatically sets the interval between songs to 3 seconds.The auto space function is always activated when the program is played back.Equipped with timer switch, alarm clock playback is also possible by using separately sold timer.Equipped with a headphone port with volume.Wireless remote control is included."

In addition, we use carefully selected materials such as composite capacitors with non-inductive electrode structure and resistors with gold-plated carbon film resistor elements molded with hard resin.In addition, the ????? is equipped with an excellent large lineout volume, and the remote control is powered by a motor to prevent deterioration of sound quality.The S servo, a newly developed predictive control method, is used in the servo circuit.The newly developed RFIC detects the position and size of dirt and dust on the disk, instantly predicts the timing of the next appearance based on the rotation cycle of the disk, and controls the servo amount of the tracking and focus feedback circuit with a microcomputer.The prediction time accuracy is as high as 1/8,000 second. Moreover, it is compatible with CLV (constant linear velocity), and this accuracy is maintained at any position in the inner and outer periphery. name: SONY
description: "A CD player developed by inheriting the technology of the high-grade machine.Digital sync ICs are used to reduce jitter that occurs when digital signals are transmitted.The pit information read from the disk is converted into a digital signal by a signal processing LSI and sent to a digital filter and a D/A converter. During this time period, jitter occurs in the digital signal. The original information of a digital signal is a sequence of encoded numerical values that is not affected by the transmission system, but when it is transmitted as an electrical signal, it is a sequence of pulse signals. For this reason, digital signals that have passed through many circuits fluctuate irregularly, with the pulse width being longer or shorter than it should be. As a result, the clock has jitter, and the time-axis accuracy of the signal deteriorates during D/A conversion.In the digital sync IC, the timing of the digital signal generated by the signal processing LSI is adjusted to the accuracy of the master clock immediately before the D/A converter. The master clock that determines the time axis accuracy of the signal is directly connected to the D/A converter. By adjusting the timing to the accuracy of the clean master clock that does not include jitter, the digital signal is adjusted again and output to the D/A converter. Since the effect of jitter does not affect the D/A converter and beyond, D/A conversion with accurate phase and faithful D/A conversion is possible.The digital filter is equipped with CXD 1244 which is an 8 fs 45-bit noise shaping digital filter.This digital filter performs 8 times oversampling and resamples the signal from 44.1 kHz to 352.8 kHz (8 times the sampling frequency) to increase the distance between the audio signal and the unwanted high-frequency components. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with gentle cut-off characteristics in the analog portion after D/A conversion, greatly improving the group delay characteristics.The CXD 1244 achieves the in-band ripple characteristics of ¥0.00001 dB and the echo level of -124dB or less due to its 45-bit high-order computing capability.The CXD 1244 is capable of performing extremely high-precision operations with a 45-bit operation bit length. However, since the D/A converter can have only a limited number of bits, round-off errors occur and remain as quantization noise. To solve this problem, we have adopted a high-resolution D/A converter with excellent characteristics and introduced a noise-shaping method, which is incorporated into the CXD 1244.Noise shaping takes advantage of an over-sampling time interval to incorporate low-order bit information that is normally lost by round-off errors into high-order data.Equipped with digital de-emphasis function.In digital de-emphasis, the de-emphasis process conventionally composed of analog circuits is digitally processed inside the digital filter, eliminating sound quality degradation caused by parts and circuits, and achieving ideal gain and phase characteristics.The D/A converter IC is equipped with a high-precision linear D/A converter.This is a high-speed operation type that corresponds to the data output speed of the 8 fs digital filter and enables more advanced D/A conversion, which improves linearity for small level signals.In addition, this D/A converter is a single-chip IC with high stability of conversion operation and realizes linear operation from the most significant bit to the least significant bit. Therefore, in principle, there is no nonlinear element in input / output characteristics. Therefore, additional circuits such as gain switching are unnecessary, and the analog circuit section is simplified.In addition, by making the left and right channels independent of each other, the phase shift between the channels is eliminated.The audio circuits after the D/A converter are twin-mono in accordance with the signal flow, eliminating phase shift and mutual interference between channels.The mechanism uses Sony's linear motor tracking mechanism that enables high-speed access with quiet operation, and is equipped with a G (Gibraltar) base unit with excellent vibration control.This is made by adding calcium carbonate, which has the same composition as marbles, to a special resin and reinforcing it with glass fiber. The Kyoshin sharpness is greatly reduced and high rigidity is obtained. In addition, the entire mechanical block has a floating structure to eliminate external vibrations and prevent unwanted vibrations and resonance.In order to eliminate the influence of sound pressure radiated from speakers, a damper made of a special rubber material is installed in the opening of the front panel where the disk tray is stored to improve airtightness when the tray is stored, thereby eliminating the influence of air vibration entering from the front.An integrated monocoque chassis is adopted for the chassis structure, and a double-structured top plate made of two sheets of steel plate is used for the top plate to increase rigidity by preventing unnecessary vibration.The servo circuit is equipped with S Servo III.The SS Servo III, noise components that cause adverse effects are removed through a low-pass filter, and the influence on the audio circuit is reduced by sending a smooth servo current to the servo circuit. Moreover, unnecessary vibration of the optical system mechanism is also suppressed.It is equipped with a custom edit function that combines three functions : time edit, program edit, and time fade.With Time Edit, you enter the time for one side of the tape and press the Edit button to program the music to be played in order from the first song. When you encounter a time-over song, the program automatically selects the longest song within the time range. Press the Edit button once to continue the program for the A side, and press the Edit button again to continue the program for the B side. The pause is automatically inserted between the A side and the B side.In program edit, you program the songs you want to put on the A side of the tape in the order you like, then press the pause button and continue to program the B side.With the Time Fade function, if you set the time beforehand, the FOMA terminal automatically fades out approximately five seconds before the time and enters a pause state.The manual fader function allows manual operation to fade in / out.With this function, the fade operation takes approximately 5 seconds from where the button is pressed.It includes custom file functionality with three functions : disk memory, custom index, and program bank.With Disk Memo, when you insert a disc, a message you enter appears on the display, followed by the number of songs and the total duration of performance. You can make a note of up to 10 characters per disc. You can use 46 letters, numbers, and special symbols.The custom index allows you to set an index of up to 10 points at any location on a single disk, even if no index information is recorded on the disk itself. The index set includes a rehearsal function that allows fine tuning in steps of approximately ¥0.15 seconds.In the Program Bank, you can directly record a program set with the Program Performance function that can play up to 20 songs continuously. You can call up the program with the File Recall button, or you can directly bank the contents of a program set with Custom Edit.It is equipped with a file recall function that allows you to check what files have been stored so far without having to insert a disk.This allows you to check without having to insert a disk, and also to erase the file contents on the spot.Equipped with a multi-mode timer function, you can start from your favorite music, shuffle play and repeat.By combining the custom index function, it is also possible to play the alarm clock with any phrase.Two types of analog output terminal are mounted : fixed and variable.The headphone port is equipped with a headphone port with a lineout linked volume that flashes when the remote control is operated.It is equipped with two digital outputs which are coaxial with the optical system.The digital output can be switched on / off.Equipped with 6 mode repeat function of 1 song / whole song / part (remote control only) / program / shuffle / custom index, and auto space function.Equipped with 2-speed Music Search that enables fast forward / fast backward while listening to music.Slow mode can only be operated from the remote control.Comes with a 20-key wireless remote control with volume control."
