name: SONY
description: "An AV control amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and equipped with DSP developed with Sony's digital technology.Equipped with DSP (Digital Signal Processor).The sound heard at concert halls and other venues consists of three types of sounds : direct sound coming from instruments and other sound sources, early reflected sound coming after bouncing off walls and ceilings several times, and main reverberation sound coming later after following a complex path. DSP is developed with the concept of creating sound fields at concert halls and other venues by controlling the magnitude, direction, length, and interval of early reflected sound and main reverberation sound.The TA-E1000ESD is equipped with two types of dedicated LSIs developed by Sony for the DSP : the CXD1355Q and the CXD1160. The CXD1355Q provides the DSP with the control of the DSP and also includes an 8 fs digital filter. The CXD1160 provides the DSP with the control of the DSP and the equalization.With Reverblation Control, you can create both early reflections and main reverberation, and you can control the timing and level of early reflections, the timing and decay time of main reverberation, etc. to create a variety of atmosphere in a performance venue.In the Sony DSP, the reverberation control is done in stereo, and the spread of the reverberation component to right and left can be expressed.Dynamics Controls highlight low-level sounds and compress the overall dynamic range, making the subtle nuances of Pianissimo easier to hear.For equalization, such as tone control, a digital signal processor (DSP) can be used to create a variety of variation curves, and in principle there is no difference in the curves between channels that occurs in analog circuits.In the TA-E1000ESD, various sound fields are created by using and combining reverberation, dynamics control, and equalization.In addition to the front 2-channel reverb control, the rear 2-channel is also generated by digital signal processing. Dynamics This roll can be adjusted in nine levels of compression (compressor) and expansion (expander).Equalization is a 3-band parametric ??? adder that can be increased or decreased in 0.1 dB steps up to ¥12 dB (1 dB on the bar graph) for each band. Also, Q (slope) can be selected from 4 types, and the center frequency can be set in approximately 90 ways in 1/9 octave (31 division on the bar graph).A total of 10 types are preset : 9 types of surround sound selected from the sound patterns produced by DSP and Dolby Prologic surround sound.The preset surround modes are Hall 1, Hall 2, Opera, Church, Jazz Club, Disco, Stadium, Live Concert, Theater, and Dolby Surround.You can create a more desirable sound field based on preset surround sound.First, there are three main parameters : room size, which controls the size of the venue ; walls, which control the frequency characteristics of the sound reflected by the wall material ; and seat position, which is also effective for correcting the AV viewing environment.In addition, you can adjust the following subparameters : initial reflection and reverberation level, initial reflection time, initial reflection level, reverberation time, reverberation density, and spreading effect level.In addition to the parameters of the reverbration control system described above, you can also adjust the dynamics to adjust the volume and source of the sound, adjust the sound characteristics of the listening room, and adjust the equalization to create the desired sound field.You can store up to 10 types of sound fields.The TA-E1000ESD supports Dolby Pro-Logic Surround. The TA-E1000ESD supports digital signal processing with DSP for delay and noise reduction. The delay time adjustment during playback can be controlled within a range of 15 ms to 30 ms in 0.1 ms steps by L/R independently.Dolby Pro-Logic Surround basically uses five speakers with a center speaker. However, it is equipped with a phantom mode that can be played with only four front / rear speakers, a normal mode that assumes the use of a small center speaker, a wide mode that can be set close to the Dolby system of a movie theater, and a 3-channel logic mode that provides surround effects with three speakers at the front left / right and center.The A/D converter employs the High Density Linear Converter System, which performs sampling approximately every 1 / 3000000th of a second and replaces each with 0 and 1 signs, thereby reducing the load on the analog filter and achieving good phase characteristics.The D/A converter is equipped with an 8 x oversampling 18-bit linear type for the front and a 4 x oversampling 16-bit linear dual type for the rear.The input jacks are equipped with seven visual systems, an audio system Line 5, and a digital input Route 3.The line outputs are equipped with two lines for the front and outputs for the surround related rear, center and subwoofer.You can enter up to 9 alphanumeric characters and symbols to display the device name on the display.In addition to the dimmer that changes the brightness according to the brightness of the room, the display itself can be partially turned off.It comes with a wireless remote controller that can perform most operations such as function switching.This remote control is programmable so that remote control signals from other manufacturers other than Sony can be memorized for all keys so that the remote control can be used to operate connected devices."

name: SONY
description: "An AV preamplifier equipped with the latest digital cinema sound technology and also compatible with DTS.These include large-capacity power transformers, electrolytic capacitors for power supplies, signal switching relays, and MELF-type resistors, all of which are carefully selected from those used in Sony's high-end Component R Series.Digital i-volume is used for the volume part.The digital i-volume is designed to take advantage of the characteristics of the current pulse D/A converter. With the current pulse D/A converter, the level of the output audio waveform can be changed by changing the value of the current source. Therefore, the digital i-volume is controlled by indicating the amount of current through the built-in microcomputer.As a result, the analog volume, which is sensitive to vibration, does not exist on the circuit, including for balance adjustment, and the volume can be adjusted without losing the resolution of digital data up to the final output terminal.It is equipped with a jitter-free D/A converter system. By performing D/A conversion using the clean clock signal of the oscillator installed immediately adjacent to the D/A converter, the jitter component (fluctuation of time axis) contained in the input clock is removed.The jitter-free signal is converted into a pulse-modulated waveform by high-speed operation at 50 MHz using an advanced pulse conversion method, a method unique to Sony that does not generate high-frequency distortion even in 1-bit D/A conversion methods.A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.Since the Advanced Pulse converted signal is a pulse train represented by a voltage, passing this signal through a low-pass filter produces an audio waveform as it is. However, the voltage pulse signal is susceptible to fluctuations in the power supply voltage, and is also susceptible to voltage-induced noise generated by digital circuits. Therefore, the current pulse D/A converter uses a clean current source for switching using voltage pulses to generate current pulses, thereby making it less susceptible to voltage fluctuations.The A/D converter is equipped with CXD8607 as an LSI for the A/D converter.To enable high-quality D/A conversion of digital signals, a 96 kHz / 24-bit interface receiver is adopted. The transmission speed of the coaxial digital input terminal is increased to 96 kHz, twice the normal transmission speed, and the usable bit tone is 24-bit.The input digital signal passes through the DSP section and is converted into an audio signal by a D/A converter. The D/A converter also has the ability to convert a 96 kHz signal into an audio waveform without downsampling.We have introduced new digital cinema sound technology with higher computing power than before.The TA-E9000ES uses two 32-bit DSPs from Shinkai to dramatically improve calculation accuracy and sound quality. In addition, the 32-bit DSP is used to receive the 32-bit DSP data for the decoder without any loss.The new Digital Cinema Sound is equipped with a Virtual Theater mode that combines the Cinema Studio mode and the Virtual 3D mode. This mode is equipped with two types of modes : a mode in which an actual rear speaker is installed, and a mode in which only the front speaker is used.Equipped with SHARC, a 32-bit DSP made by Analog Devices Inc. for decoding Dolby digital.The SHARC is a 32-bit floating-point DSP that provides better sound quality than that of traditional 20-24 bit precision fixed-point DSPs.The RS 232 c interface is installed for upgrading the surround program.It comes with a bi-directional remote control with a 4.5 inch liquid crystal touch panel.For the TA-E9000ES, two types of upgrade kits were released.The VUCD-E9000A can support Cinema Studio EX and Virtual Matrix 6.1 developed after the release of the TA-E9000ES.The BS-E 9000 b is compatible with MPEG-2 AAC decoding, which is a VUCD digital audio system."

name: TA-N9
description: "This monaural power amplifier was developed with the latest technology and devices aiming at the highest performance and sound quality as a power amplifier to reproduce high-quality sources with a large dynamic range more faithfully, which was born with the appearance of PCM equipment.A high-voltage double-diffused MOS-FET is used for the power element.The V-FET used in Sony amplifiers had greatly improved basic performance such as distortion factor compared with transistors. However, the negative bias of the V-FET makes it difficult to use in applications. For example, in the TA-N7, a measure was taken to improve this. For example, a cascode connection with a transistor with superior high-frequency characteristics was used. The power MOS-FET (2SK173/2SJ54) used in the TA-N9 was developed by further expanding and developing the high-withstand voltage technology of 1000 V and the power FET manufacturing technology obtained at the time of trial manufacture of the V-FET. Among MOS-FETs, it has a double-diffused structure that is considered advantageous for high-frequency characteristics and high-withstand voltage.When a power amplifier is composed of this power MOS-FET, a large output can be easily obtained because it can handle a large current (up to 10A) at a high withstand voltage (210 v). In addition, it has high reliability and safety, and because it has excellent high-frequency naked characteristics, there is little transient intermodulation distortion.The TA-N9 uses this element for the output stage in 5-pair parallel push-pull operation.The circuit configuration of the amplifier section consists of a DC differential amplifier circuit with dual FET for the first stage and current mirror load. The second stage consists of a DC amplifier with an active amplifier. The voltage amplifier stage has a bare gain of approximately 100 dB. Moreover, since the bare characteristics before applying NF are improved, the distortion in the NF loop is also greatly reduced. The power driver stage is driven by a small transistor with excellent high-frequency characteristics because the input impedance of the power MOS-FET is large.The complete DC amplifier configuration eliminates the problem of phase rotation in the low frequency range.We have developed and adopted a heat pipe for audio equipment for the heat radiation part.Since the TA-N9 has a large output, the maximum signal voltage is ¥90 V and the instantaneous current is 16A. This can affect the output stage to the first stage of the power amplifier. In particular, when the wire of the power element of the output stage is routed, the half-cycle signal of the SEPP circuit in Class B operation jumps out as electromagnetic wave and enters the first stage circuit, causing distortion of sound.To solve this problem, a heat pipe is used. A special liquid is enclosed in a copper pipe, and heat is transferred instantaneously from one end of the pipe to another by continuously vaporizing and liquefying the liquid. This heat pipe has a thermal conductivity several hundred times that of a metal rod of the same diameter of copper or silver, and the conduction speed is close to the speed of sound. In addition, there is almost no temperature difference between stores, so efficient heat radiation is possible.The power MOS-power MOS-FET of the final stage element can be concentrated and mounted on a printed circuit board, and heat is instantaneously guided to the heat radiation fins. In addition, aluminum shielding materials and shielding pipes are used for the input system to minimize the influence of electromagnetic waves.TA-N9 can switch between class A operation and class B operation.Since there is essentially no switching distortion during class A operation, more beautiful sound quality and low distortion are possible. In addition, since class A / B switching system with equal amplifier gain is used, you can enjoy the difference between class A and class B sound while listening.A Pulse Locked Power Supply is used for the power supply.The operation principle of the pulse-locked power supply is as follows : First, 100 VAC is directly rectified, then this DC is converted into a 20 kHz pulse, transformed by a high-frequency transformer, and rectified again to obtain the power supply voltage of the amplifier. In addition, in order to suppress voltage fluctuations caused by changes in the output signal of the amplifier section, a constant voltage circuit using a chopper method is inserted to convert the fluctuations into pulse width and control them.In this system, the signal system is almost in a DC state just by rectification, so that the signal system is not interfered by noise caused by the power supply such as hum. In addition, as long as the capacity of the transformer is basically the same, transmission efficiency is better at higher frequencies than at lower frequencies. However, the pulse lock power supply is set at a high frequency of 20 kHz and uses a ferrite core with less high-frequency loss, thereby realizing higher efficiency than conventional power supplies using large toroidal transformers.In addition, since the voltage is controlled to be constant by the pulse width control circuit, there is almost no voltage fluctuation up to the rated output of 0 to 450W. This suppresses the displacement of the amplifier stage due to the fluctuation of the power supply voltage, and the saturation is extremely small even at high power.Since the pulse lock power supply directly rectifies the AC input power supply, the power supply frequency is not limited. Also, it can be operated with DC input (DC110V ~ 140 V). In addition, since it has extremely constant voltage characteristics, it has no effect even if the AC power supply fluctuates from 90 V ~ 130 V.The TA-N9 uses a large-capacity pulse-locked power supply and a two voltage Minamoto no Sadamu system with a pulse-width constant voltage circuit inserted into each of the two positive and negative systems to reduce the fluctuation of the mid-point voltage. In addition, a four terminal capacitor is used to reduce the impedance rise at high frequencies. The TA-N9 achieves low output impedance characteristics from the DC range to the audio range.The pulse lock power supply used in the TA-N9 has a sealed structure with strict electromagnetic shielding to prevent electromagnetic waves from affecting the amplifier circuit. The power supply consists of eight transistors for oscillation and eight transistors for regulator, which generate a large amount of heat. To cope with this situation, the power supply is mounted on a heat pipe.A cylindrical high-frequency transformer with ferrite core with low high-frequency loss is used for pulse oscillation and electromagnetic conversion to improve efficiency. The coil of this transformer is also made of copper belt-like material to reduce impedance.In order to achieve high reliability, a forced air cooling system using a DC motor is adopted.This motor uses a linear BSL (slotless) motor with extremely low mechanical and electrical noise, reducing heat generation and rotational noise of the motor itself, and improving reliability.As a protection circuit, a circuit with temperature detection, DC detection, and impedance detection is adopted.Equipped with 6 point peak power indicator with LED.This indicator is not intended to continuously monitor the output level, but rather to check the clip of the power amplifier or the power supplied to the speakers.Since the peak power is required to be accurate, the attack time is 30 Ï‰ sec to improve the response characteristics. Generally, 1/10 of the peak level is said to be the average level. For example, when the 500W point of the indicator lights occasionally on an 8 � speaker, approximately 50W of power is supplied to the speaker.Equipped with a 2-dB-step level attenuator that combines a resistor and a rotary switch.The input level can be easily set. Moreover, the step type prevents inadvertent movement in case of a mistouch. In addition, the noise degradation is reduced by the structure of the resistor with very little error.A large screw-type terminal is used for the speaker terminal in consideration of contact resistance and aging, and 4 mm thick cable can be used for this terminal.The input pin jack uses a gold-plated terminal with low contact resistance and little change over time.Since the TA-N9 is a complete DC amplifier configuration, if the preamp connected to the TA-N9 has a DC leak, the DC detection of the power amplifier will move or the vibration system of the speakers will change. To cope with this problem, the TA-N9 has a C-Coupled terminal, which cuts frequencies below 1.5 Hz at -6dB/oct. with a capacitor that has been carefully examined in terms of phase characteristics and sound quality.A glass-epoxy substrate with excellent electrical and mechanical properties is used.In addition, the copper foil of the pattern is also 175 Ï‰ thick to emphasize the sound quality."

name: TA-N88
description: "A high-grade stereo power amplifier equipped with a PWM system (pulse width modulation system) and PLPS (pulse lock power supply) utilizing digital technology.The TA-N88 uses the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) method.In the analog amplification method used in conventional audio power amplifiers, the output side of a power amplifier is inserted between a load (speaker) and a power supply, and the power flowing to the load is extracted by changes in the internal resistance of the element. In contrast, in the PWM method, which handles pulse signals, the output can be extracted by the ON/OFF operation of the amplifier.In an analog amplifier, the amplifying element functions as a resistance. In the PWM method, the amplifying element functions as a switch. Therefore, in principle, there is no power loss caused by the amplifying element in the analog amplifier. In reality, since the resistance value of the amplifying element is not 0, the efficiency is 80% - 90%.In order to realize this digital amplifier, it is necessary to convert an audio signal into a digital signal. For example, when an analog signal of 20 kHz is amplified, this signal modulates a carrier of 500 kHz into a digital signal (PWM wave). The waveform width of the digital signal of 500 kHz (pulse wave) changes in proportion to the level of the analog signal.On the circuit, the amplifying element performs ON-OFF operation at intervals of 2 Ï‰ sec (500 khz), and the ON-OFF time of the amplifying element changes according to the level of the analog signal. Therefore, the output is the product of the ON time of the amplifying element and the applied power voltage. This power-amplified digital signal is passed through a low-pass filter and returned to the original audio signal.The PWM amplifier section of the TA-N88 consists of an input high-speed attenuator, a carrier oscillation circuit, an integrator circuit, a high-speed comparator circuit, a V-FET gate drive circuit, a V-FET switching circuit and a low-pass filter.An input high-speed attenuator is an attenuator that uses an FET as a resistance element. It protects the amplifier by attenuating the input at a response speed of 1 Ï‰ sec or less so that the current flowing through the V-FET of the output stage does not exceed the rated current when the load is short-circuited by mistake or when an excessive input is applied to the amplifier.In the carrier oscillator circuit, a sine wave of 500 kHz generated by a Colpitts oscillator circuit is converted into a square wave with uniform duty through a differential amplifier, and is sent as a carrier (carrier signal) through a buffer amplifier of an emitter follower for L and Rch.Because the integrator circuit subtracts (integrates) the injected audio and carrier signals (square waves) from the output signal, the integrator circuit must have a very broadband frequency response from the audio band to the high-frequency band of the carrier (DC to several MHz).Because the high-speed comparator circuit requires extremely fast response characteristics, it is composed of an IC, which is a 3-stage series of differential amplifiers. It operates with input voltage level differences of less than 1 square wave output (PWM wave) with a response time of less than 20 nsec (1/50,000,000 sec).The V-FET gate drive circuit amplifies the approximately 8Vp-p output of the PWM modulated wave to a 40-Vp-p square wave voltage required to drive the gate of the V-FET used for power amplification in the final stage.The V-FET switching circuit consists of a parallel push-pull circuit using four V-FETs per channel newly developed for high-power switching. This V-FET device enables high-power switching of up to 160 v and 10A in 50 nsec.A low-pass filter extracts only the audio signal component from a pulse-width modulated signal. This circuit uses a low-loss LC-type filter with coils and capacitors.A Pulse Locked Power Supply (PLPS) is used for the power supply.The principle of operation of this power supply is as follows : First, 100 VAC is rectified directly, then this DC is converted into a 20 kHz pulse, transformed by a high-frequency transformer, and rectified again to obtain the power supply voltage of the amplifier. In addition, a constant voltage lock circuit using a chopper method is inserted to suppress voltage fluctuation caused by output fluctuation of the amplifier section by converting the fluctuation into pulse width and controlling it.The pulse lock power supply consists of rush current suppression circuit, primary rectifying circuit and smoothing circuit, chopper type constant voltage circuit, 20 kHz power oscillator, pulse width control circuit, ferrite core transformer, secondary rectifying circuit and LC smoothing circuit.In the primary rectifier circuit, input of 90 v to 130 v AC is bridge rectified to obtain 130 v to 168 v DC. In case of DC input, it is transmitted as it is along the polarity of the diode.In the 20 kHz power oscillator, a self-excited bridge oscillation circuit using four high-power switching transistors is used to stably oscillate high power pulses of 20 kHz.Ferrite core transformers are used to transmit 20 kHz pulses. Even at the high frequency of 20 kHz, they use ferrite cores with low loss, high magnetic permeability, and high saturation magnetic flux density. Therefore, they have 55 times more power transmission capacity than conventional power transformers used at 50 Hz. In addition, they have excellent regulation because the total wire length of the winding is shortened.The secondary rectifier circuit supplies the necessary DC voltage to each amplifier stage. Since the primary side is constant voltage by pulse width control method, stable power output can be obtained.In the pulse width control circuit, the square wave obtained by the 20 kHz power oscillator is converted into a triangular wave, and the level is compared with the reference voltage to obtain a pulse for controlling the chopper type constant voltage circuit.In the chopper type constant voltage circuit, a constant voltage is maintained by electronically turning ON / OFF the DC obtained in the primary rectifying circuit by the pulse from the pulse width control circuit.The pulse-locked power supply has the advantage of almost no ripple due to the pulse rectification system, high efficiency due to high frequency, and extremely stable power supply voltage due to the pulse-locked system.The PWM amplifier and PLPS power supply handle frequencies as high as 500 kHz and 20 kHz, respectively. Therefore, these frequencies and their harmonics may interfere with each other or affect external devices.To prevent this, the TA-N88 is equipped with a filter that traps harmonics at the AC input, speaker output, input terminal, etc. to prevent frequency leakage.In addition, since the whole aluminum is a shield case made of aluminum die-cast, high-frequency pulses do not leak outside."

name: TA-N9000ES
description: "A 5-channel power amplifier developed for use with the TA-E9000ES.A dynamic 5-amp system is used, and all channels are in the same stage, including the rear channel, which has been assigned a smaller output than other channels. This allows for more powerful surround playback.The TA-N9000ES can be used as an independent 5-channel amplifier, as a 2/3/4-channel amplifier, or as a BTL connection for connecting two blocks of amplifier circuits to form a single high-output amplifier.It has an extra input terminal in addition to the normal 5-channel input terminal, so you can connect a preamp for pure audio.Uses a direct ground drive system that reexamines the relationship between the power amplifier circuit and the power supply.Conventional amplifiers have a structure in which the output of the transformer is sent to a rectifying circuit and supplied to each power transistor from the rectifying circuit. However, in the direct ground drive system, the power transformer is directly connected to the speaker load, and the load current is supplied directly from the power transformer. This enables high-speed and high-power power supply and improves the sense of volume and rhythm of low sound.A crab-shaped ground unit is used for the ground circuit that is important for this system. This component uses a copper plate 1 mm thick, equivalent to 30 times the thickness of a normal printed pattern, with 10 branch points and an appropriate connection sequence to realize a ground circuit with extremely low impedance.The power amplifier block is designed as a discrete configuration with all channels separated.A surface mount circuit board is used for the circuit board so that five amplifier circuits can be constructed without difficulty. This structure is resistant to vibration. Lead-type electrolytic capacitors for high sound quality that are not suitable for surface mounting are used. The MELF resistor developed in Sony's high-grade component R series is used in place of the rectangular chip resistor. For example, the MELF resistor is used in place of the rectangular chip resistor.A mill wrapper rate dual-chip power transistor is used for the output stage.This transistor consists of two power transistor chips with the same characteristics arranged close to each other on a single copper plate. This ensures the same heat balance, and the current path also passes close to each other, minimizing the generation of distortion associated with the synthesis.A large power transformer of EI 111x100 size is used for the power supply.This transformer uses a wrap-packed core. Normally, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated to form the core, and E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are stacked alternately to form the core. Although this structure requires time and effort to manufacture, it is advantageous in terms of sound quality. Since there are no faults in the magnetic path, leakage of magnetic flux is sharply reduced and the influence on the audio circuit is minimized.The amplifier circuit, including the heat sink and input terminal, is mounted on the inner chassis and separated from the exterior chassis by the vibration surface. Furthermore, by using a slant-mount substrate, which is mounted with the substrate slightly tilted, the generation of standing waves is suppressed and resonance is reduced.The inner chassis is a monocoque structure using a single seamless steel material.The chassis uses FB chassis that absorbs and attenuates vibration due to loss of joints.The heat sink adopts a newly developed ""sf"" heat sink with a vibration dispersion fin structure to suppress fin resonance.Each fin of this heat sink is equipped with ribs in different positions to prevent tuning fork vibration, suppress split vibration, and minimize coloring to music.A gold-plated input terminal is used for the input terminal, with careful consideration of sound quality in the substrate and processing method itself.The speaker terminal is large enough to accommodate the Y terminal and banana plug."

name: SONY
description: "An FM/AM tuner incorporating Wave Optimaizer Technology (waveform optimizing technology) into each stage of the circuit.An SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) is used for the front end.First, the band pass filter is synchronized with the FM broadcast signal, and when the frequency changes, the control voltage is changed so that the center of the band pass filter also has the same frequency.This flattens the filter characteristics in the band and completely eliminates the front-end distortion.In order to reduce the tracking error, the varactor diode of the local oscillator and the varactor diode of the RF tuning section are separated. By adding a correction voltage to the control voltage of the RF tuning section, the receiving frequency is divided into four and the tracking error is reduced to 1/4 of the conventional one.The SST circuit operates only when the IF band is wide and the signal input is 35 dBf or higher because the distortion factor becomes worse when the IF band is narrow band is narrow, and there is a mode that increases noise.WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) is adopted for the IF stage.In the IF filter, WOIS optimizes the group delay characteristics for monaural and the amplitude characteristics for stereo to ideal waveforms. As a result, we have succeeded in greatly reducing distortion while maintaining high selectivity.In addition, an IF band switching circuit is also installed to cope with severe reception conditions that cause interference even with WOIS.WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) is adopted for the detection stage.This method utilizes the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, which is an oscillating element in the VCO (Voltage Controlled Oscillator) circuit, varies with the operating frequency to optimize the nonlinearity of the VCO, and an ideal straight line can be obtained depending on the characteristics of the FET.In the MPX stage, a new PLL MPX IC (CXA-1064) with more than 500 elements has been developed and is equipped with a Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decoder (WODSD).In this system, L and R demodulation signals obtained by 38 kHz switching are switched by a blend switch with signals obtained by balanced multiplication of 38 kHz and 114 kHz, and finally the switching signal itself is made close to a sine wave without harmonics. Even if the composite signal has distortion components, the switching signal has few harmonics components, so that the distortion is not demodulated into the audible frequency band.As a result, a beat-cut filter is no longer needed, and the phase and amplitude of the composite signal are transmitted as they are, further eliminating interference while maintaining high-purity sound quality.It uses a direct converter method, and by raising the comparison frequency to 100 kHz, which is the same as the channel plan, beats and noise that pollute the sound are greatly reduced.To prevent the small vibration of the power transformer from being transmitted to the chassis, the transformer and the chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance.In addition, the ES filter that improves the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself, and an electrolytic capacitor that is four times larger than the conventional one is used as the power supply for the signal system, thus realizing a comfortable power supply circuit with less noise.The LC filter is completely removed from the detection stage to the outlet of the tuner, eliminating distortion and other causes of sound quality degradation.An active filter is used for the MPX filter of the final stage, and holes are made in the top plate of the printed circuit board after the detection stage to prevent the influence of magnetism on sound quality.The an integrated chassis, rigidity is strengthened, and together with legs which are about 6 times larger than conventional ones, vibration is protected firmly.In addition to the frequency of the target broadcasting station, it is equipped with various functions such as an FM/AM random preset function using multi-process memory that simultaneously stores reception conditions such as muting ON/OFF, FM auto / stereo / mono, and FM IF BAND position, two tuning mechanisms of auto / manual, and a 4-station program memory with timer support that allows recording of absence across 4 stations.It is equipped with an FM IF band switching function that can always obtain high quality even under different reception conditions when receiving FM signals.The AM section is equipped with a 4-element ladder filter.Equipped with F-type connector for 75 � coaxial antenna."

name: ST-S333ESXII
description: "FM/AM tuner which adopted analog sense tune by tuning dial.Equipped with a tuning dial. There are three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as conventional analog tuners, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically by turning a little to either left or right and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up 20 preset memories one after another by turning the tuning dial.The generation of digital noise is greatly reduced by suspending the operation of the microcomputer except when necessary for operation.In the ST-S333ESXII, when no operation is performed for approximately 10 seconds, the condition is maintained in the peripheral circuit and the microcomputer is deactivated.The FM antenna terminal is located almost in the center of the rear panel, making it possible to lay out the power supply part located almost in the center of the board so that each part surrounds it. In addition, the ground reference point is also placed in the power supply part, from which it supplies power to each stage.As a result, the power supply and each stage can be connected at the shortest distance, reducing the power supply impedance, preventing loops from forming in the power supply system, and reducing sound quality degradation by connecting each stage at the shortest distance.It is equipped with a switch that can pass the MPX filter if necessary.It is equipped with a direct comparator, which employs a PLL IC that can directly handle frequencies as high as 220 MHz. This raises the comparison frequency to 100 kHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations, and reduces noise and by interference with the pilot signal.To prevent the vibration of the transformer from being transmitted to the chassis, the transformer and the chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance, and an ES filter is used to improve the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself.The LC filter, which causes distortion and other sound quality degradation, is eliminated from the detection stage to the output terminal of the tuner, and an active filter is used for the MPX filter.To prevent the resist material from increasing the capacitance between the patterns, we have adopted a unique ES substrate with a resist material placed only on the copper foil.An SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) is mounted to reduce distortion at the front end.At the SST circuit, in order to reduce tracking errors, the frequency band from 76 MHz to 90 MHz is divided into four bands, and the error range is reduced by adjusting each band point.It is equipped with WOIS (Wave Optimaized IF System) which optimizes IF waveform to achieve both high selectivity and high sound quality.When an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth is used in order to improve the interference rejection capability, simply narrowing the bandwidth and increasing the selectivity will result in a deviation from the originally required parabolic curve and distortion. In WOIS, compensation curves are created and synthesized to form an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth and a parabolic curve.In the case of a monaural signal, a curve to correct the group delay characteristics of the filter is created and synthesized.Equipped with WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) to improve the performance of the detector stage.In the WODD, we focus on the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, which is an oscillation element in the VCO circuit, shows non-linearity at the operating frequency, which is opposite to that of a varactor diode. Create a linear VCO by overlapping two curves.The MPX part is equipped with WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decoder).In WODSD, a 38 kHz square wave and a square wave obtained by the balanced multiplication of 38 kHz and 114 kHz are added together to produce a switching signal that is less likely to generate third harmonic waves, thereby suppressing beats caused by interference with 100 kHz disturbance waves.It is equipped with program memory function corresponding to timer of 4 stations.It is equipped with functions such as memory scan and cartone."

name: SONY
description: "FM/AM tuner with improved reception performance and operability while inheriting digital tuning using a tuning dial.Although it is a synthesizer tuner, it has a tuning dial.It is equipped with three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as a conventional analog tuner, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically when it is turned a little to either left or right, and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up a station stored in a preset memory.In addition, the ST-S333ESG is equipped with an auto-preset scan mode in which preset stations are received for approximately 4 seconds in sequence by simply turning the dial slightly to either left or right.You can turn off the display except when necessary for operation such as channel selection.Wave Optimizer Technology includes four technologies : SST, WOIS, WODD, and WODSD.SST (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) has a role to reduce distortion at the front end.On the front end, there is a phenomenon called tracking error, which occurs when the center frequency of the band pass filter deviates from the reception frequency. In order to reduce this, the SST divides the frequency band from 76 MHz to 90 MHz into 32 bands, and adjusts each band point to minimize the error range.WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) is a system that optimizes IF waveform to achieve both high selectivity and high sound quality.The IF (Intermediate Frequency Amplification) stage accurately amplifies the intermediate frequency of 10.7 MHz and eliminates adjacent station interference that cannot be eliminated at the front end by the IF filter. In order to improve the interference rejection capability, it is good to use a filter with a narrow bandwidth. However, if you simply narrow the bandwidth and increase the selectivity, the curve becomes more and more triangular, and even necessary components cannot pass through, causing distortion.Therefore, WOIS has the role of converting a curve that approaches a triangle into an ideal parabola. By creating a correction curve with a double-headed curve around the center frequency and synthesizing it, an IF filter with a narrow bandwidth that draws a parabola is constructed.The Wave Optimized Direct Detector (WODD) is a detector stage whose performance has been thoroughly reviewed.WODDs focus on the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET, the oscillation element in the VCO circuit, shows non-linearity at the operating frequency, which is opposite to that of the varactor diode. By superimposing the curves of the FET and the varactor diode, a linear VCO is created.WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder) is a demodulation circuit developed to realize an excellent stereo signal.In WODSD, a 38 kHz square wave and a square wave obtained by balanced multiplication of 38 kHz and 114 kHz are added to produce a switching signal that does not generate third harmonic waves.Radial power supply is used for circuit construction. The power supply (rectifier circuit) is placed at the required position on the board, and each part is laid out to surround it. The ground reference point is also placed in the power supply.As a result, we succeeded in reducing the impedance of the power supply by bringing the power supply unit closer to each other, eliminating the power supply loop and connecting each unit at the shortest distance.By adopting a direct comparator and using a PLL IC that can directly handle the high frequency of 220 MHz, the comparison frequency is raised to 100 kHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations. By this, it is sufficiently separated from the 19 kHz pilot signal and 38 kHz sub signal, and noise and beat generation are greatly reduced.It is equipped with two antenna input terminals and can be used for stations with different transmission points.Equipped with an RF direct mode that can bypass a high-frequency amplifier, distortion generation in a strong electric field area is greatly reduced.A total of 30 FM/AM random preset memories are installed.It is equipped with a program memory function that enables you to record your absence by changing the receiving station at each reservation time.A pure circuit design is used to reduce noise by turning off the microcomputer during reception.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to tune from the listening position."

name: SONY
description: "FM/AM tuners incorporating the design philosophy of the Sony ES Series.It is equipped with an SST circuit (Super Sound Tracing Circuit) that reduces distortion at the front end.The front-end bandpass filter of a quartz-lock synthesizer tuner consists of a coil and a variable voltage element (varactor diode). In the SST, the control voltage of the varactor diode is corrected to optimize the filter characteristics for FM modulated waves.In addition, the conventional front-end has a problem that the largest tracking error occurs near the center of the reception frequency band. This was caused by the fact that the control voltage of the varactor diode of the local oscillator of the front-end and the varactor diode of the RF tuning section were made to be the same. However, the ST-S555ES separates this and adds an appropriate value to the control voltage of the RF tuning section to divide the reception frequency band into eight and reduce the tracking error.Note that the SST circuit does not operate unless the IF band is wide and the signal input level is sufficient, because the distortion factor becomes poor when the IF band is narrow, and there is a mode that increases noise. The indicator to the left of the central display lights during operation.It is equipped with WOIS (Wave Optimized IF System) which optimizes IF waveform and combines high selectivity with high sound quality.WOIS optimizes the group delay characteristics of the IF filter for monaural operation and the amplitude characteristics of the IF filter for stereo operation so that the distortion generated at the IF stage can be greatly reduced while maintaining high selectivity.Equipped with WODD (Wave Optimized Direct Detector) to improve the performance of the detector stage.The PLL system consists of a phase comparator, a low-pass filter, and a VCO (Voltage Controlled Oscillator). The IF signal is directly detected by operating the VCO at around 10.7 MHz. However, with the conventional PLL detector, it was difficult to obtain a linear characteristic of the controlled voltage versus oscillation frequency characteristics of the varactor diode used in the VCO.The WODD optimizes the nonlinearity of the VCO by taking advantage of the fact that the feedback capacitance of the FET which is the oscillation element in the VCO circuit varies with the operating frequency.The MPX section is equipped with WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder).In the ST-S555ESX Server, the WODSD consists of high-speed ICs. The pilot signal in the composite signal is once generated at 152 kHz by PLL, and is used to output 6-phase signals of 0 � / 45 � / 135 � / 180 � / 225 � / 315 � at 38 kHz, thereby generating extremely low-distortion switching signals.This WODSD completely eliminates the LC filter from the signal system and greatly improves the interference characteristics. The ST-S555ESX also uses low-noise, high-slew rate (20 v Ï‰ s typ.) audio OP amp and low-distortion switching device for high sound quality.Using a direct comparator method, beat and noise are reduced by raising the comparison frequency to 100 kHz, which is the same as the channel plan.Equipped with two antenna input terminals that can connect and switch two antennas for the target broadcasting station.It also has a multi-pass indicator that helps you set the best antenna direction.The control and signal windings of the power transformer are made independent to improve sound quality. In addition, the transformer and chassis are mechanically floated using materials with different specific acoustic impedance in order to prevent the small vibration of the power transformer from being transmitted to the chassis.In addition, an ES filter is used to improve the frequency characteristics of the transformer winding itself.In order to minimize the adverse effect of magnetism on sound quality, we have adopted a top plate with a hole in the vicinity of the audio stage and a unique ES substrate that prevents deterioration of sound quality due to increased electrostatic capacitance between patterns caused by resist.Equipped with 4-station timer compatible program memory function.It also has a 10-station random preset function.It is equipped with memory scanning function and cartone function."

description: "This FM stereo tuner incorporates a variety of technologies to improve sound quality through best tuning.The FM front-end section is equipped with a CG varicon that provides high indication accuracy, thereby eliminating interference waves.Spurious and image interference ratios are improved and intermodulation interference is reduced by tuning circuit of double tune and quad tune configuration utilizing 7-series varicon, and mixer circuit of dual gate MOS FET with remote cutoff characteristics.By using a uniphase filter in the IF section, both high selectivity and high distortion factor are achieved.In addition, the selection characteristics of Normal/Narrow can be switched by the bandwidth selection switch.PLL IC is used in the multiplex stereo demodulation circuit.The PLL compares the phase of the switching signal for MPX demodulation with that of the pilot signal and controls it so that it is always in the same phase. description: "An FM/AM/TV tuner that inherits ES Series technology and can receive TV sound.Although it is a synthesizer tuner, it has a tuning dial.It is equipped with three operation modes : manual, which has the same feeling as a conventional analog tuner, auto, which starts searching for radio waves automatically when it is turned a little to either left or right, and stops when it is found, and dial preset scan, which calls up a station stored in a preset memory.Equipped with WODSD as Wave Optimizer Technology.WODSD (Wave Optimized Digital Stereo Decorder) is a demodulation circuit developed to realize an excellent stereo signal.In WODSD, a 38 kHz square wave and a square wave obtained by balanced multiplication of 38 kHz and 114 kHz are added to produce a switching signal that does not generate third harmonic waves.Radial power supply is used for circuit construction. The ground reference point is also placed in the power supply.As a result, we succeeded in reducing the impedance of the power supply by bringing the power supply unit closer to each other, eliminating the power supply loop and connecting each unit at the shortest distance.By adopting a direct comparator and using a PLL IC that can directly handle the high frequency of 220 MHz, the comparison frequency is raised to 100 kHz, which is the same as the channel plan of Japanese FM stations. name: SONY
description: "A record player equipped with a slotless magnetic circuit motor and a magnedisk servo.In order to reduce torque unevenness caused by cogging (changes in magnetic attraction force and mechanical torque) that occurs in DC motors, we have adopted a brush-and-slotless motor with a structure that does not have slots in principle.This motor consists of a concentric circular solid core, a trapezoidal wave magnetized magnet ring, and a saturable inductor. Since the rotational force generated by the motor is proportional to the amount of magnetic flux passing through the coil and the amount of current flowing, if the amount of current is constant, the rotational force is proportional to the amount of magnetic flux. Therefore, the amount of magnetic flux must be uniform in order to suppress torque unevenness during rotation.The slotless motor uses a trapezoidal wave magnetizing method for the magnet ring to obtain uniform magnetic flux density.In addition, in order to detect the relative positional relationship between the stator coil and rotor magnetic pole, a magnetic window is provided in the magnet ring, and an electronic control system that senses magnetism with a saturable inductor is adopted. Stable rotational force is obtained by effectively using a constant magnetic flux.In order to obtain more accurate rotational speed, a unique magne-disk servo system is adopted for the servo circuit.This system is a high-precision speed control function that introduced Sony Magne-scale precision measuring equipment technology that measures things in the micron unit or less. The outer circumference of the turntable that can be taken in a wide range is coated with barium ferrite with high coercive force. Around this circumference, 512 speed detection signal is magnetized with high density. The signal is detected at an average value with an 8-tooth double-gap head, and high-precision and stable servo detection is realized.In addition, since the generated signal frequency is as high as approximately 284 Hz at 33 1/3rpm, the servo compensation frequency band can be widened, and the slight delay and advance during rotation can be accurately captured, and quick response characteristics can be obtained.The cabinet uses SBMC, an acoustic material with high internal loss and low resonance.In order to take full advantage of the features of SBMC, thickness and structure were comprehensively examined, and resonance parts were eliminated by integral molding with reinforcement at important points to realize a frame structure resistant to resonance.In addition, a large, height-adjustable insulator is integrated with the cabinet and attached to lower the center of gravity to increase the stability of the cabinet.Uses XL-15, which is a MM type cartridge.The XL-15 is composed of a conical damper that suppresses unnecessary vibration caused by friction between the sound groove of the record board and the needle tip, a resin containing carbon fiber in the pole piece block, and a magnetic circuit with excellent left and right balance.The tone arm uses a high-sensitivity static balance type, and the bearing uses a precision pivot bearing to increase the sensitivity. In addition, each joint including the pivot is supported by a damper to provide anti-vibration design.The head shell is made of aluminum light alloy and is lightweight, highly rigid and non-resonant.And, it is equipped with inside for scan seller and lateral balancer.A stroboscopic illumination prism is mounted on the peripheral strobe, making it easy to see the stroboscopic pattern.33 equipped with independent pitch control for 2 speeds of 33 1/3 and 45 rpm.A remote oil dump type arm lifter is adopted.Uses a rotatable arm rest for easy needle pressure adjustment.Uses a low-capacity phono cord.Equipped with 2 replacement shell stands.Comes with a removable acrylic dust cover."

name: SONY
description: "A direct-drive player system that employs a crystal lock system and magnedisk servo.In order to solve the problem of rotational speed accuracy, a crystal lock servomechanism is adopted.Unlike conventional servo circuits, a phase control circuit for crystal oscillation is added to the magne-disk speed control circuit. This circuit has features such as small changes in rotational speed due to ambient temperature and aging, and is not affected by fluctuations in power supply voltage, frequency, and load.The servo motor uses a Magne-disk servo system based on the technology of the Sony Magne-scale precision measuring instrument. The turntable is magnetized with 512 wave signals over a wide area around the circumference. The 8-tooth multi-gap head detects the average value of these signals, making it possible to detect them with high accuracy and stability.In addition, since the servo response range is greatly expanded, the servo effect is improved, and good load characteristics and wow / flutter characteristics are obtained.Using an electronic brake, the brake is applied not only during stop operation, but also when switching from 45 rpm to 33 1/3rpm, and it quickly enters into steady rotation.Since it is an electronic brake, there is no excessive burden on the mechanism.Speed switching by pitch control is possible.Since the crystal lock effect is large, the pitch control operation is performed by removing the crystal lock.The turntable uses die-cast aluminum of precision processing with deadening, and it has the effect of reducing resonance sharpness.In addition, an oil dump type insulation mat is used for the turntable seat, which is a special liquid with high viscous resistance enclosed in soft rubber to suppress the vibration and resonance of the phonograph record.It uses a purely electronic non-contact detection auto return, reducing the contact resistance of the mechanism and making the movement of the arm smooth.The cabinet uses a newly developed SBMC by Sony.This SBMC is a thermosetting reinforcing resin that combines a polyester resin base with calcium carbonate and glass fiber. It is 1.5 to 2 times stronger than wood (lauan plywood) and has less than one third the resonance sharpness (Q) of aluminum die-cast.By using this material, howling is suppressed and the SN ratio is improved.The tone arm uses a static balance S-shaped universal tone arm.A carbon pipe arm is used for the arm pipe part. By annealing the carbon fiber with direction to obtain rigidity, the rigidity is increased and resonance resistance characteristics are obtained. In addition, the arm support part is equipped with a 2-point type release bearing using jewel with high sensitivity, lateral balancer, inside for scan celler, gold plated connector, etc.The arm lifter is a remote type.The head shell uses SH-160, a carbon-clad shell. This head shell is made by laminating carbon fiber on aluminum material, and suppresses resonance of the head shell called shell squeal, and makes the reproduction sound clear.A special insulator with high vibration absorption rate is used for the leg part of the player case.Equipped with touch-feeling start / stop and reject switches.Dust cover with anti-static treatment is included."

name: SONY
description: "A full-auto player system equipped with an all-electronic tone arm ""Biotracer"".It is equipped with a biotracer that electronically controls all the complicated movements of the tone arm.In the biotracer, a speed sensor, a position sensor and a linear motor are installed in the vertical and horizontal directions of the arm, respectively. The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor and controls the movement of the arm. The speed sensor works to smooth the movement of the arm and at the same time improve the acoustic characteristics such as resonance and inside force. The position sensor works in conjunction with a 128 word x4-bit microcomputer to operate the arm such as full auto operation, needle pressure adjustment and inside force cancellation. It usually makes several hundred logical judgments for each movement, checks the arm position, speed and status of each operation switch, and processes commands at a speed of less than 1/1000 second.With this biotracer, it is possible to suppress the peak of the low-frequency resonance frequency (fo) within 3 dB regardless of the type of cartridge used, and crosstalk is also improved.It is also strong against warping of records, improved wow flutter, and strong against howling.Auto lead in / Oatley turn is possible, and each time is set to ergonomically pleasant 6 seconds.Equipped with a photoelectric record size selector, it automatically detects the size of the record (30 cm, 17 cm).If you press the start button without setting a record, the needle returns without dropping.Equipped with auto-repeat function.The needle pressure can be adjusted simply by controlling the front panel knob, and the applied needle pressure value is digitally displayed.In addition, the anti-skating force corresponding to the needle pressure is calculated and automatically applied to the arm.An electronic non-contact mechanism is adopted.In addition, it has a built-in muting mechanism linked with the arm lifter to eliminate the shock noise when the needle tip touches the record.In addition to general full auto operation, auto operation of tone arm only and turntable only is possible.It has a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot.By eliminating the slots that cause cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is achieved. In addition, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved.The velocity detection unit of the servo system uses a magnet-disk velocity detection system. The inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable, which has a wide rotating area, is coated with magnetic material. The detection signal of 512 waves is magnetized, and the average value is detected by the multi-gap head, and the control command is sent to the servo system.Since this method has a high signal frequency of approximately 284 Hz at 33 1/3rpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components.Magnedisk A crystal lock is adopted by adding a phase control circuit of crystal oscillation to the detected speed servo circuit. By phase locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heat generation of the body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heat generation and rotational speed decrease due to needle pressure load are reduced, and excellent rotational characteristics are obtained.The neck cylinder part, which is the joint part between the head shell and the arm pipe, holds the tip of the shell plug against the slope facing the bottom of the neck cylinder with a strong force due to the wedge effect. In addition, the locking nut is pushed forward by the reaction, and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from 4 directions.As a result, two parts of the front and back are held in a ring shape by one operation, preventing mounting looseness.The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity, and by adopting a J-shape with high bending strength, rigidity approximately 8 times that of conventional aluminum pipe is obtained.In addition, by adopting an integrated structure from the neck cylinder section to the bearing section, unnecessary joints are eliminated and resonance factors caused by joint looseness are eliminated.The bearings use a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft to prevent play caused by ball bearings. This minimizes movement at the operating point.In addition, a tapered mirror finish of hardened cemented carbide with a diameter of 5 mm is used for the pivot shaft to improve contact with precision radial bearings and provide high rigidity support."

moving, or if a foreign object is caught between the turntable and the cabinet, the motor will run after stopping for approximately 15 seconds.When playing with the turntable body pulled out, it raised.Equipped with an auto record size selector, the player automatically detects whether a set record is an LP or a doughnut, and ensures that the Tornan arm is led in at the beginning of the given first track.In addition, this auto record size selector detects when the start button is pressed without placing a record and returns the arm to protect the needle tip.Equipped with a muting mechanism that eliminates shock noise when the needle tip touches or leaves the record board.It is also equipped with a contactless end detection mechanism that detects the end of the performance of a name: SONY
description: "A full auto player with improved operability and reliability through the introduction of a microcomputer.The built-in microcomputer processes commands for selecting record sizes, read-in / return operations, repeat playback, and other operations. In addition, the arm's motor and electronic circuit provide smooth and safe auto operation.The end-of-record detection mechanism uses a contact-less system with enhanced reliability.Linear BSL motor is used.Because this motor does not require a brush or slot, torque unevenness is reduced, and quiet and smooth rotation is achieved. Moreover, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are improved.Magnedisk speed detection is used for the speed detection part of the servo circuit.In this system, the multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal, which is densely magnetized on the turntable, and captures minute changes in the rotational frequency. 33 Since the generated signal has a high frequency of approximately 284 Hz at 1/3rpm, servo compensation is possible up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components.The speed signal obtained by the magnet-disk speed detection is compared with the reference signal and controlled to maintain the correct rotational speed. However, the temperature characteristics of the element used in this case may affect accurate servo control. To solve this problem, we have adopted a crystal lock that controls the phase of the detected signal.By taking advantage of the high oscillation precision of quartz crystal, stable rotational characteristics that are resistant to changes in ambient temperature, power supply voltage and frequency are obtained.In the tone arm part, the connection of each connection part is strengthened and integration is promoted as much as possible to eliminate resonance.The neck cylinder, which is the junction between the head shell and tone arm, holds the tip of the shell plug with a strong force due to the wedge effect and tightens the root of the shell plug from four directions.The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity and has a J-shaped structure with high bending strength. Thus, the arm pipe has approximately eight times the rigidity of conventional aluminum pipes. This pipe has an integrated structure from the neck cylinder to the bearing.In order to prevent the gap between the ball bearings in the bearings section from causing play and to prevent the operating point of the arm from blurring, we have adopted a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft with a long distance between four points. This minimizes the movement of the operating point against slight play of the bearing section.In addition, the PS-X55 has high sensitivity for light needle pressure and high compliance type cartridges.Uses MM type cartridge XL-15.The cabinet uses an acoustic material, SBMC, which is less likely to resonate than metals and has high precision and strength. Partial resonance is suppressed by considering the thickness and structure in a comprehensive manner and reinforcing the structure at important points.In addition, a thick and strong dust cover has been adopted to improve vibration damping characteristics.Gel-like dump material is enclosed in the insulator to realize effective vibration absorption."

name: SONY
description: "This is a full-auto-player system equipped with a full-auto mechanism that pursues safety and usability based on the concept of human auto-mechanics.Equipped with a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot. By eliminating slots that cause cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is realized.In addition, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved.The velocity detection section of the servo system employs a Magne-disk velocity detection method developed using precision measurement technology of the Sony Magne-scale. Magnetic material is coated on the inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable with a wide rotating area, and 512 wave detection signals are magnetized. The average value of these signals is detected by a multi-gap head, and control commands are sent to the servo system.Since this method has a high signal frequency of approximately 284 Hz at 33 1/3rpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components.In addition, the speed servo circuit uses a crystal lock with a crystal oscillation phase control circuit. By phase-locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heating of the main body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heating and rotational speed drop due to needle pressure load are reduced, resulting in excellent rotational characteristics.In order to prevent lateral pressure from being applied to the needle tip when the tone arm returns, an electronic record end detection type Luminous sensor is used.In addition, an arm limiter mechanism is adopted to protect the mechanism by separating the auto mechanism when a force larger than the driving force is applied to the tone arm.The cartridge is equipped with MM type cartridge XL-25A.The neck cylinder part, which is the joint part between the head shell and the arm pipe, holds the tip of the shell plug against the slope facing the bottom of the neck cylinder with a strong force due to the wedge effect. In addition, the locking nut is pushed forward by the reaction, and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from 4 directions.As a result, two parts of the front and back are held in a ring shape by one operation, preventing mounting looseness.The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity, and by adopting a J-shape with high bending strength, rigidity approximately 8 times that of conventional aluminum pipe is obtained.In addition, by adopting an integrated structure from the neck cylinder section to the bearing section, unnecessary joints are eliminated and resonance factors caused by joint looseness are eliminated.The bearings use a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft to prevent play caused by ball bearings. This minimizes movement at the operating point.In addition, a tapered mirror finish of hardened cemented carbide with a diameter of 5 mm is used for the pivot shaft to improve contact with precision radial bearings and provide high rigidity support.The SBMC is used for the cabinet because internal loss is larger than metal and the structure with high precision and strength can be easily obtained.It uses a large insulator filled with gel-like high-viscoelastic material in a rubber cup.The height of this insulator can be adjusted to keep the cabinet horizontal, and the center of gravity is lowered to further improve stability.Uses low-capacity cord with gold-plated terminal."

name: SONY
description: "This full-auto player system uses a dedicated motor for arm drive and logic circuit to solve the problems of full-auto.In addition to normal full auto operation, auto operation of tone arm only or turntable only is possible.We have adopted a record-end detection type Luminous sensor that does not apply lateral pressure to the needle tip. We also respond quickly to continuous operation instructions even in the event of an operation error. Through these measures, we have taken thorough measures to protect the needle tip.In addition, when a force larger than the arm driving force is applied, the auto mechanism is separated so as not to put a burden on the mechanism.It is equipped with a muting mechanism that reduces noise when the needle tip goes down or leaves the record board.It is equipped with a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot in order to eliminate torque unevenness, which can be said to be the destiny of a DC motor. By eliminating the slot that causes cogging, torque unevenness is minimized and smooth and quiet rotation is realized.In addition, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also improved.The velocity detection section of the servo system employs a Magne-disk velocity detection method developed using precision measurement technology of the Sony Magne-scale. Magnetic material is coated on the inner wall of the outer circumference of the turntable with a wide rotating area, and 512 wave detection signals are magnetized. The average value of these signals is detected by a multi-gap head, and control commands are sent to the servo system.Since this method has a high signal frequency of approximately 284 Hz at 33 1/3rpm, servo compensation can be performed up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components.Magnedisk A crystal lock is adopted by adding a phase control circuit of crystal oscillation to the detected speed servo circuit. By phase locking the detected signal, not only initial drift due to self-heat generation of the body, but also rotational speed deviation due to voltage fluctuation due to self-heat generation and rotational speed decrease due to needle pressure load are reduced, and excellent rotational characteristics are obtained.The neck cylinder part, which is the joint part between the head shell and the arm pipe, holds the tip of the shell plug against the slope facing the bottom of the neck cylinder with a strong force due to the wedge effect. In addition, the locking nut is pushed forward by the reaction, and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from 4 directions.As a result, two parts of the front and back are held in a ring shape by one operation, preventing mounting looseness.The arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy with greatly increased rigidity, and by adopting a J-shape with high bending strength, rigidity approximately 8 times that of conventional aluminum pipe is obtained.In addition, by adopting an integrated structure from the neck cylinder section to the bearing section, unnecessary joints are eliminated and resonance factors caused by joint looseness are eliminated.The bearings use a Longs pan bearing shaft supported by a single straight shaft to prevent play caused by ball bearings. This minimizes movement at the operating point.In addition, a tapered mirror finish of hardened cemented carbide with a diameter of 5 mm is used for the pivot shaft to improve contact with precision radial bearings and provide high rigidity support.The SBMC is used for the cabinet because internal loss is larger than metal and the structure with high precision and strength can be easily obtained.It uses a large insulator filled with gel-like high-viscoelastic material in a rubber cup.The material filled in this insulator is very flexible, has high internal losses, and has moderate spring elasticity, which enables effective vibration absorption.In addition, the height of this insulator can be adjusted to keep the cabinet horizontal, and the center of gravity is lowered to further improve stability.Litz wire is used for parallel wiring inside the arm, and a low-capacity cord with gold-plated plug is used."

name: SONY
description: "A full-auto player equipped with a contactless full-auto mechanism based on the electronic control arm ""Biotracer"".The biotracer is equipped with a speed sensor, a position sensor and a linear motor in the vertical and horizontal directions of the arm, respectively. The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor and controls the movement of the arm. The speed sensor works to smooth the movement of the arm and simultaneously improve the acoustic characteristics such as resonance and inside force. The position sensor works in conjunction with a 128 word x4-bit microcomputer to operate the arm such as full auto operation, needle pressure adjustment and inside force cancellation. It usually makes several hundred logical judgments for each operation, checks the arm position, speed and status of each operation switch, and processes commands at a speed of less than 1/1000 second.This biotracer suppresses the peak of the low-resonant frequency fo to less than 3 dB and improves crosstalk. It is also resistant to record warping, has improved wow and flutter, and is resistant to shock and howling.The tone arm can be moved left and right, the turntable can be operated independently for strict queuing, and the needle pressure can be adjusted by the knob on the front panel for fine-tuning the needle pressure during performance.Since it is a contactless system, smooth and quiet operation is realized.In addition, it has a built-in muting mechanism linked with the arm lifter to prevent shock noise when the record meets the needle tip.Equipped with a record size selector that automatically selects the record size. In addition, if you press the start button without setting a record, the needle will return without dropping.In addition, the inside force cancel force corresponding to the needle pressure is automatically activated.It uses a simple linear BSL (slotless) motor that does not require a brush or slot. It eliminates the slot that causes cogging, so it achieves quiet and smooth rotation with less uneven torque.In addition, high torque can be obtained due to high efficiency, and reliability and durability are also excellent.The Magne-disk speed detection method is used to detect the speed of the servo circuit.In this system, the multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal that is magnetized at high density on the turntable, making it possible to catch even minute changes in the rotational speed. In addition, since the generated signal has a high frequency of approximately 284 Hz at 33 1/3rpm, servo compensation is possible up to relatively high frequencies of the flutter components.It is equipped with a crystal lock so that the temperature characteristic of the element can ignore the effect on the detection signal.By controlling the phase using the high oscillation precision of quartz crystal, stable circuit characteristics are obtained without being affected by changes in ambient temperature and power supply voltage and frequency.By strengthening the joint of each connection part of the tone arm and promoting integration as much as possible, resonance elimination is attempted.First, the neck cylinder mechanism, which is the joint of the head shell and tone arm, has a structure in which the tip of the shell plug is held by strong force due to the wedge effect and the root of the shell plug is tightened firmly from four directions.In addition, the arm pipe is made of a special aluminum alloy and has a J-shaped structure with a high bending strength, giving it approximately eight times the rigidity of conventional aluminum pipes. In addition, this pipe has an integrated structure from the neck cylinder to the bearing.In order to prevent movement of the operating point of the arm by looseness caused by the clearance for rotating the ball bearing in the bearing section, we have adopted a structure in which the arm is supported by a straight shaft with a long distance between the fulcrums. This minimizes movement of the operating point even in the case of slight looseness of the bearing section.The SBMC sound material is used in the cabinet, and the partial resonance is reduced by examining all aspects such as thickness and structure, and by providing reinforcement in important parts.In addition, vibration is reduced by making the dust cover thick.A gel-like dump material is enclosed in the insulator to reduce the adverse effect of vibration."
