name: SONY
description: "This is a full-auto player that thoroughly pursues the ideal of picking up all the music information engraved in the sound groove from every angle.It is equipped with Sony's original biotracer.This is a system that electronically controls all operations with a microcomputer that makes several hundred logical decisions every one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and linear motors. With this system, the low-frequency resonance peak can be suppressed to less than 3 dB regardless of the type of cartridge installed. At the same time, the crosstalk is also improved to realize excellent low-frequency reproduction.In addition, the wow and flutter sensation is reduced, and sound quality such as rise, localization, dynamic range and distortion sensation is improved.Linear tracking system is adopted for the arm part.In order to prevent rattling at the base of the tracking arm, which is a problem with this method, we have been thoroughly eliminating resonance based on the know-how obtained in the development of the biotracer. This reduces tracking error and enables clearer music playback.The rotary system employs a 3-stage block configuration, incorporating the most advanced technologies in the development of motor technology and control system to enable the turntable to rotate quietly and smoothly.By removing the brush and slot from the DC motor, the BSL motor which fundamentally eliminated the cause of torque unevenness, the magnet-disk speed detection which quickly catches minute rotation changes by average detection signal of high-density magnetization on the turntable with the multi-gap head, and the quartz lock which performs accurate servo by utilizing high oscillation accuracy of the crystal, stable rotation characteristics are acquired.Equipped as standard with an MC cartridge (XL-333E) with replaceable needle using an air core 8 shape coil using samarium-cobalt.It uses an electronic needle pressure application method that allows the needle pressure to be adjusted by the volume controller on the panel even during recording performance.Equipped with a with a queueing mechanism that can move the tone arm left and right by button operation. The movement within 5 mm left and right is designed to move slowly so that accurate head positioning is possible.Equipped with a quick repeat mechanism in which the arm does not return to the rest position and immediately resumes playing from the head of the record board.Equipped with an opto-electronic disc size selector that automatically selects the size regardless of whether it is 17 cm EP or 30 cm cmLP, and the tone arm accurately leads in.In addition, even if the start button is pressed without setting the record needle, the needle tip does not drop and returns as it is.Equipped with a muting mechanism that cuts the output until the needle tip comes down and eliminates noise when the needle tip touches the record board.The cabinet is made of SBMC material with strength and sufficient internal loss, and uses a large insulator filled with highly viscoelastic material.By using RM-65 which is sold separately, it is possible to play synchronized with Sony deck."

description: "Full auto-player system with MC cartridge installed as standard.It is equipped with a biotracer that controls all operations electronically by means of a microcomputer.By electronically controlling all operations with a microcomputer that makes hundreds of logical decisions every one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and linear motors, it is possible to limit the low-frequency resonance peak to less than 3 dB no matter what cartridge is used, to improve cross-modulation distortion and low-frequency crosstalk, and to trace even records with slight warpage.The cartridge is equipped with an MC cartridge XL-333E with an air core 8 coil made of samarium-cobalt and with a replaceable needle.It is equipped with a Lummus Straight Arm that brings out the goodness of the light needle pressure high compliance cartridge and makes use of the traceability of the biotracer.In addition, in order to increase the rigidity of the arm pipe, the special aluminum alloy is tapered to increase the rigidity and suppress the influence of unwanted resonance.The rotation system employs three stages : a linear BSL motor in which the brush and slot are removed from the DC motor to completely eliminate the cause of torque unevenness ; a magnet-disk speed detection in which the average value of the detection signal that is magnetized at high density on the turntable is detected by a multi-gap head to catch even small changes in rotation speed ; and a quartz lock in which accurate servo is achieved by utilizing the high oscillation accuracy of quartz crystal. These three stages achieve stable rotation.It employs an electronic needle pressure application method in which the needle pressure can be adjusted by the volume controller on the panel, and the inside force cancel amount corresponding to the needle pressure can be set simultaneously.As a result, the deviation of the proper needle pressure value due to the change of environmental temperature can be adjusted while listening to the playback sound.In addition to the normal auto operation, the front panel controls manual-like operations such as up / down of the tone arm and start / stop of the turntable.Strict queuing is possible without touching the arm.Equipped with an opto-electronic disc size selector that automatically selects the size of the record and leads in the tone arm. This mechanism also serves as a protective function that the needle does not work when there is no record.Equipped with a muting mechanism that eliminates the generation of noise when the record board and needle tip contact.The cabinet uses SBMC with large internal loss to eliminate resonance.We have also adopted a large insulator filled with a highly viscoelastic material.By using the sync unit sold separately, it is possible to play sync with the cassette deck."

name: SONY
description: "Equipped with an auto 0 balance mechanism and digital display of needle pressure, this full-auto player system further expands the potential of biotracer.The tone arm is equipped with a biotracer which is an electronically controlled tone arm.The tone arm consists of a microcomputer that makes hundreds of logical decisions in one thousandth of a second, speed and position sensors, and a linear motor that electronically controls all operations.As a result, the low-frequency resonance peak can be suppressed to less than 3 dB regardless of the type of cartridge used. At the same time, the crosstalk is also improved, resulting in excellent low-frequency reproduction.It is also robust against sleigh records, and reduces the wow and flutter sensation, resulting in improved overall sound quality.The arm pipe is made of an aluminum alloy with increased rigidity and has a J-shaped structure with high bending strength, achieving rigidity approximately eight times that of conventional aluminum pipes.In addition, the arm pipe to the shaft is integrated with a single straight shaft to prevent movement of the operating point and suppress unnecessary vibration of the arm.Equipped with a contactless opto-electronic auto-disc size selector that automatically selects the record size and provides a safety function to prevent the tone arm from dropping when no record is installed.The rotating system uses a 3-stage block consisting of a linear BSL motor, magne-disk speed detection, and quartz lock.By adopting a linear BSL motor without brushes and slots in the DC motor, the mechanical torque change called cogging is eliminated, and quiet and smooth rotation is realized. Moreover, high torque is obtained due to high efficiency.In the magnet-disk speed detection, a multi-gap head detects the mean value of the detection signal, which is magnetized at high density on the turntable, and detects minute changes in the rotational speed. Also, since the generated signal frequencies are relatively high, servo compensation is possible up to the higher frequencies of the flutter components.It uses a quartz lock and utilizes the high oscillation accuracy of quartz to obtain stable rotational characteristics even with changes in ambient temperature and power supply voltage and frequency.In order to reduce the effect of vibration, an acoustic material SBMC is used for the cabinet, and an insulator filled with a high viscosity elastic material is used for the insulator.It employs an auto 0 balance mechanism that eliminates the need for 0 balance adjustment when the cartridge is replaced. When the tone arm is brought near the armrest, the 0 balance of the arm is automatically adjusted.In addition, when the auto 0 balance circuit using the microcomputer does not balance the 0 balance, the digital needle pressure display flashes to give a warning.The needle pressure can be adjusted electronically by means of a needle pressure control volume located on the front of the instrument. The needle pressure value is displayed in digital form. The needle pressure can be adjusted even while playing the record, so that the optimum value can be obtained while listening to the performance.In addition, proper anti-skating is automatically set according to the needle pressure setting.The tone arm's lead-in / out, up / down, and all other operations are driven by a linear motor driven by a microprocessor circuit and can be operated with the dust cover closed.It is equipped with a queuing function, and the left and right movement of the tone arm can be controlled by a button. The tone arm moves slowly for the first 5 mm and then moves rapidly.Equipped with an electromagnetic brake, it instantly ensures normal rotation when changing the rotational speed.Equipped with a muting mechanism. Since it is structured so that muting is released when the needle tip is completely lowered, noise does not occur when the needle tip touches the record board.By using the separately sold synchronized remote control unit, it is possible to play synchronized with the cassette deck."

name: SONY
description: "A linear tracking player system equipped with an active trace servo system in addition to a biotracer.Biotracer is used for the tone arm part.In the biotracer, a speed sensor, a position sensor and a linear motor are installed on the vertical rotating part and horizontal driving part of the arm, respectively. The signals detected by the two sensors are sent to a servo amplifier, which supplies the necessary current to the linear motor to control the movement of the arm.In addition, it is easy to follow the disk. It can reproduce slight warpage and eccentricity without any problem. In addition, we have succeeded in suppressing the low-frequency resonance peak to less than 3 dB regardless of the cartridge used. This makes it possible to bring out the original character of the cartridge. It also improves crosstalk.Linear tracking system equipped with newly developed active trace servo is adopted.Active Trace Servo is based on the major premise that the disk pitch always moves inward while varying variably. The motor for arm cross-feed is rotated in advance, and the change in pitch is read by the biotracer position detection sensor. When the pitch becomes coarse, the moving speed of the arm is increased, and when the pitch becomes fine, the moving speed of the arm is decreased. By this, the speed of the needle tip and the speed of the arm support are almost matched.With this active and race servo, the arm can move continuously without stopping while slightly changing the moving speed. This eliminates the so-called wild chervil caterpillar movement and greatly reduces phase distortion caused by sudden movement of the arm support.In order to eliminate the rattling of the arm support part which is a problem in the linear tracking system, the slide bearing by the mono-rail guide which matches the support shaft of the horizontal feed with the arm support point is used for stabilization, and the rattling is suppressed by the powerful damping force of the biotracer.A linear BSL motor of the same system as the turntable is used for the motor for arm cross-feed.The turntable motor uses a linear BSL motor that was developed based on the Nohha for the turntable for consumer players and cutting machines. There is no slot (groove) that causes torque unevenness, and the brush is removed for a simple structure.The speed detection section of the servo circuit uses a Magne-disk speed detection method that employs precision measurement technology of the Sony Magne-scale. The multi-gap head detects 512 wave signals that are magnetized with high precision on the periphery of the turntable. This method enables servo compensation up to relatively high frequencies of flutter components.In addition, in order to prevent the accurate servo from becoming ineffective due to the temperature characteristics of the element, we have adopted a quartz lock that controls the phase of the rotational frequency by utilizing the high oscillation accuracy of the crystal. This ensures stable rotational accuracy that is not affected by fluctuations in ambient temperature or power supply voltage.When the rotation is stabilized, the Locked indicator on the front panel lights to indicate that the quartz lock has been performed.The tone arm has a square pipe to increase rigidity and suppress natural vibration.In addition, the shell connector is also devised, and the tip of the shell plug is held by strong force due to the wedge effect, and the base is tightened from four directions using a neck cylinder mechanism.The SBMC has been adopted for the cabinet, which is less likely to resonate due to its larger internal loss than metal, can be machined with high precision, and has greater strength.In addition, a large rubber cup filled with a gel-like high-viscosity elastic material is used for the insulator, and an acrylic dust cover, which is resistant to howling, is used for the dust cover, thereby suppressing vibration from the outside in both solid propagation and air propagation.Equipped with auto 0 balance function, vertical speed sensor and linear motor replace counter weight to automatically take 0 balance.In addition, since the needle pressure adjustment is an electronic needle pressure application method that makes use of the power of the linear motor, it can be controlled while the disk is being played back.Almost all operations can be done with the front panel buttons except for replacing the disc.In addition to the normal auto operation such as start / stop of performance, Oatley peat, and rotation number switching, the dedicated BSL motor enables the tone arm to feed left / right, needle tip up / down, and turntable start / stop operation.If you press the FAST button at the same time as the left / right feed button of the arm, the moving speed will be increased.The size is automatically detected by the optoelectronic disk size selector.In addition, even if the start button is pressed without setting the disk, the needle tip does not move downward and returns as it is.Equipped with muting circuit linked to up / down of tone arm.It is always muting on when it is up, so you do not need to reduce the volume of the amplifier when you change the cartridge.The separately sold synchronized remote control unit allows synchronized play with the cassette deck."

name: SONY
description: "AV amplifier with built-in FM/AM tuner equipped with unique visual touch mechanism.It comes with a one button remote control that transmits radio waves. It can be operated with a single remote control while watching the screen displayed on the monitor. This one button remote control uses a gyroscope to detect the vertical and horizontal angle change of the hand holding the remote control and convey it as the movement of the pointer on the screen.UHF-band radio waves are used instead of infrared waves to transmit remote control signals. Compared with infrared waves, radio waves have the advantage that signals can easily reach even if there are obstacles such as sofas.Commands from the one button remote control are retransmitted from the infrared transmitter on the front panel of the AV amplifier to control the VCR and LD player. Since the AVU-1000 is designed for wide directivity, it can be operated with almost no problem even when stored in a rack.Since the AVU-1000 is equipped with a remote control signal learning function, it is compatible with AV equipment manufactured by other companies than Sony. In addition, the AVU-1000 can operate lighting devices, electric screens, and other devices that are controlled by infrared remote controls.It has a visual Line 5 and four audio inputs.It is equipped with functions such as Auto Start which can set the source started when the power is turned on, Auto Play which automatically starts playback only by selecting a function, and Sound Field Link which can link sound field programs to functions.In addition, it is equipped with an auto program function that automatically executes a series of operations such as switching the function to LD, turning off the light, and playing back the LD. Two programs can be set independently up to 10 steps. Each step can also be set with a waiting time (1 second, 2 seconds, 5 seconds, 10 seconds).It is equipped with 10 sound field programs including Dolby Pro Logic.In particular, two programs, Theater and Live, add the sound of a theater and the sound of a concert hall to the signal output from the Dolby Pro Logic Decoder. You can enjoy Dolby stereo movie and music software in the atmosphere of a movie theater or concert hall.Equipped with a digital surround processor, it is equipped with various parameters that simulate the size of the room, the material of the wall, the front-rear and left-right positions of the seat, etc., and can be set according to the sound field program.Equipped with a 3-band digital equalizer that can adjust the bass, mid and treble independently.Both bands can be increased or decreased by ¥10 dB in 1 dB steps. The Mid band adopts a parametric method that can change the slope (Q) characteristics in addition to selecting the center frequency, so that sound can be created according to the source to be reproduced and the situation.For example, you can listen to a CD while watching a video, and you can select the image of a visual device and the sound of an audio device independently from each other for simultaneous casting playback.It has a built-in FM/AM tuner that uses a quartz lock digital synthesizer system.30 random station memory is available, and the original radio station name can be displayed on the screen.The A/D converter uses a 1-bit A/D converter that performs high-magnification oversampling operations, while the D/A converter uses noise-shaping technology and a pulse D/A converter that reproduces sound with pulse density.Built-in power amplifier for 5 channels.Using an optical device that controls the bias signal at high speed, it is equipped with an optical legato linear system that reduces switching distortion and crossover distortion, and an S. T. D. (???????? Twin Drive) power supply that supplies power separately and independently from the rectifier circuit. This reduces interference between the voltage amplification stage and the output stage."

description: "An AV amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and DSP with ES technology.In addition to the digital signal processing of the delay and decoder circuits, the auto-input balance and test tone circuits are also processed by digital signals.The power amplifier section contains a 5-ch power amplifier.Especially, the front and center power amplifiers are all discrete components.ES Technology S. name: TA-AV900D
description: "An AV amplifier equipped with audio processing by digital delay and video processing by digital picture.Eight types of digital picture processing are available for all video input systems except S video input.With Picture-in-Picture, you can display images from different sources on the sub screen while playing images on the main screen.Stop motion can play noisy still images from VTR, TV, or LD (CLV).Flash Motion allows you to view a video or TV image with a strobe effect. The flash interval can be switched in five steps between approximately one tenth of a second and two seconds.The Digital Multi-Flash can simultaneously display images in flash motion on a multi-screen. The multi-screen can be divided into 4/9/16 divisions. The flash interval can be set to approximately one tenth of a second to 1 second with 5-step auto, and manual operation at any interval is also possible.With 4 x Digital Zoom, you can magnify part of the screen to an area four times larger than the entire screen. You can zoom up to five areas : center, upper left, upper right, lower left, and lower right.The Mosaic Art feature allows you to mosaic an image.With Picture Art, you can create a solarization by enhancing the contrast of an image. You can choose from three levels of effect : strong, medium, and weak.TV Scan combines the ST-AV900 AV tuner with the TV Tuner to convert preset TV programs into digital still images and display them sequentially on a multi-9 screen. It is also possible to display video one station at a time.Digitally processed images can be output from the S-image connector to the monitor.When S-Video Direct ON is selected, the S-Video Input signal is directly output at the shortest distance. When S-Video Direct OFF is selected, the video input signal (excluding input via the S-Video Terminal) is digitally picture-processed and output.Three types of surround processing are possible using digital delay for audio input.With Dolby Surround, you can use Dolby Surround software, with Hall Surround, which gives you the reverberation of a concert hall, and with Simulated Surround, which changes the sound from a mono source into a wide-ranging stereo signal.In either case, the delay time can be selected in 3 stages of 15/20/25ms.You can switch modes, select the delay time and adjust the volume of the rear speaker with the remote control from the viewing position.It is equipped with a D/A converter and input / output terminals for digital sources, and supports sampling frequencies of 32 khz, 44.1 khz and 48 khz.A programmable remote controller capable of operating the TA-AV900D is included.With this remote control, even AV devices other than Sony can program and store remote control signals in memory if they are compatible with infrared remote control. The program can be in up to 98 mode.There are 2 variations, black and titanium gray."

description: "An AV amplifier with a Dolby surround processor.It is equipped with a surround function that you can enjoy with a total of 2 channels in the front and 2 channels in the rear.In Dolby Surround mode, surround hardening is reproduced when you play a video tape with the Dolby Surround mark, and you can also enjoy Dolby Surround playback in Dolby Stereo movies stereo broadcast transmission on TV.In Concert Hall mode, you can enjoy a wider range of sound that cannot be obtained with stereo playback.In Simulated Stereo mode, you can extend the sound of a mono source.It has built-in amplifiers for a total of four channels, two main speakers and two rear speakers.Four video channels and audio Route 3 input / output jacks are installed.Two video monitor output systems are installed : a video output system and an RF output system for televisions without an input terminal.Equipped with a center output jack that sends out the front stereo signal in L + R monaural.When dubbing from Video2 to Video1, it is equipped with a BGV (background video) function that allows you to exchange the sound with the source selected with the function switch.Equipped with a master volume that can adjust the volume of the front and rear side simultaneously.It also has a slide-type surround volume that can adjust the volume from the rear speaker independently of the master volume.Equipped with a slide-type tone control to adjust the front bass and treble.You can also control the left and right volume balance of the front side.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to switch between surround modes, adjust front and rear volume simultaneously, turn the power on / off and mute."

name: TA-V606
description: "An AV amplifier equipped with digital cinema sound technology.With a 5.1 channel input, you can enjoy 5.1 channel surround sound with a DVD player with a Dolby digital processor, or 3-1 stereo sound with a 5.1 channel input.It is equipped with a cinema studio mode using digital cinema surround, which is Sony's original surround technology.Cinema Studio Mode allows you to enjoy the sound effects of three different types of Sony Pictures Entertainment studios.A dynamic 5-amp system with front L/R, center and rear L/R amplifiers is adopted, enabling more powerful surround playback.A large transformer with a wrapped core is used for the power supply.In conventional EI core transformers, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined (welded or bonded) to form the core. However, by adopting a wrap-packed structure in which E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are stacked alternately, there is no part that is cut in a fault in the magnetic path, reducing leakage of magnetic flux.The electrolytic capacitor is also equipped with a large-capacity and large-size type for pure audio that is carefully selected through repeated trial listening not only in electrical characteristics but also in acoustic characteristics.The heat sink uses a high-rigidity large heat sink made of extruded aluminum that is tuned to suppress harmful fin squeal. The heat sink itself is also firmly fixed to the chassis body to reduce vibration structurally.The legs are equipped with an eccentric insulator.The eccentric insulator has a structure with a screw hole to avoid the center position, and by changing the phase of vibration, it is canceled and transmission to the chassis is reduced.Equipped with base boost function, you can increase the impact of low sound with one touch.It has a direct pass switch that allows you to bypass surround, tone control and base boost circuits as needed.The SA-IF70 can be used as a rear speaker with a dedicated terminal that can be combined with the optional wireless speaker SA-IF70.There are 2 color variations of gold and titanium gray.Wireless remote control with learning function is included."

name: TA-V909
description: "An AV amplifier with a built-in Dolby digital processor equipped with digital cinema sound technology.A 24-bit DSP is used for decoding the Dolby Digital.It can be connected to the digital output of the DVD player to decode and amplify Dolby Digital.It supports the bus redirection function of Dolby Digital and allows you to divide the low-frequency range to other speakers. This allows you to enjoy dramatic surround sound playback even when you use a small speaker that tends to lack the low-frequency range, by letting the subwoofer handle only the low-frequency range.The crossover network processing for low-pass extraction is done in the DSP with 24-bit processing at the digital stage.It is equipped with Cinema Studio mode and Virtual 3D mode by digital cinema surround, which is Sony's original surround technology.Cinema Studio Mode allows you to enjoy the sound effects of three different types of Sony Pictures Entertainment studios.In the Virtual 3D mode, you can create a sound field unique to a movie theater more actively by making full use of 3D acoustic technology. It is equipped with various modes : Virtual Multiria, which allows you to enjoy the feeling of being surrounded by many rear speakers, Virtual Rear Shift, which allows you to get a sense of a wide sound field like a movie theater, and Virtual Enhanced Surround A/B, which allows you to play back the sound of the rear with only the front speakers.In addition to the surround mode of digital cinema sound, it is equipped with a total of 29 programs and 56 surround modes, including modes for reproducing sound fields of concert halls and live houses.You can also tune up to your preference by adjusting various parameters based on preset modes.The D/A converter is equipped with a full-feed-forward digital filter and an advanced pulse D/A converter.In the full-feed-forward digital filter, low-order bits, which were previously rounded off, are transmitted through a separate route, stored in memory, and combined with the result of the next stage operation. This enables oversampling operations that also reflect low-order bit data, thereby almost completely eliminating requantization noise within the audible band.In the TA-V88ES, the advanced pulse D/A converter is integrated into a single LSI together with a full feed-forward digital filter to achieve more stable operation.Each of the front, center, and rear channels has its own digital equalizer that can adjust high and low tone in the digital domain.A dynamic 5-amp system with front L/R, center and rear L/R amplifiers is adopted, enabling more powerful surround playback.The power stage uses a parallel transistor with two NPN-type and two PNP-type elements arranged on the same plate. This allows the temperature environment to be matched and the amplification characteristics to be matched. In addition, the plate on which the elements are mounted is of a large size. It functions as a stabilizer to prevent sudden changes in temperature to improve stability.A large transformer with a wrapped core is used for the power supply.In conventional EI core transformers, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined (welded or bonded) to form the core. description: "ES series AV amplifier with built-in Dolby digital processor equipped with digital cinema sound technology.A 24-bit DSP is used for decoding the Dolby Digital.It can be connected to the digital output of the DVD player to decode and amplify Dolby Digital.It supports the bus redirection function of Dolby Digital and allows you to divide the low-frequency range to other speakers. This enables oversampling operations that also reflect low-order bit data, thereby almost completely eliminating requantization noise within the audible band.In the TA-V88ES, the advanced pulse D/A converter is integrated into a single LSI together with a full feed-forward digital filter to achieve more stable operation.Each of the front, center and rear channels has its own digital tone controller that can adjust the high and low tone in the digital domain.A dynamic 5-amp system with front L/R, center and rear L/R amplifiers is adopted, enabling more powerful surround playback.The power stage uses a parallel transistor with two NPN-type and two PNP-type elements arranged on the same plate. T. D. power supply circuit, which is an arrangement of the S. T. D. power supply circuit installed in the pure audio amplifier for the AV amplifier, is adopted. name: SONY
description: "This ES series AV amplifier is compatible with Virtual Matrix 6.1 mode and Digital Concert Hall mode.It is equipped with the Virtual Matrix 6.1 mode corresponding to the 6.1 a new surround system standard for movie theaters.In this mode, the rear channel, which used to be two channels, is divided into three channels : left, center, and right to clarify the sound localization of the rear part.Virtual Matrix 6.1 mode includes Cinema Studio Reverbation (B), Virtual Multi-Dimensional and Screen Depth Matching, which are included in Cinema Studio EX mode. In addition, the rear center speaker is implemented as a virtual speaker for the case where the surround environment is already available in 5.1 channel.It is equipped with a digital concert hall mode to enjoy 2-channel stereo sources such as CDs as a concert hall.In the Digital Concert Hall mode, DSP technology is used to create the reverberation that is not included in the software, and it reproduces the impact of a live concert in which the stage and the audience come together.In the Digital Concert Hall Mode, the acoustic characteristics of the Comcell ???? Hall in Amsterdam and the Musique Feline Saar in Viennea are carefully measured and incorporated into the DSP, and the reverberation sound falling on the audience seats is reproduced by virtual speakers using virtual 3D technology.The A mode reproduces the Consell ???? Hall, and you can enjoy the sound field feeling that the initial reflection sound is rich, the stage is very large, and the height of the hall is high. The B mode reproduces the Muzik Feline Saar, and you can enjoy the rich reverberation without the initial reflection sound being conspicuous. In either mode, you can select the amount of reverberation to be generated, with the Standard at the center and three positions of dry (low reverberation) and wet (high reverberation), and the amount of reverberation can be adjusted.Equipped with Cinema Studio EX mode.This mode integrates cinematic studio reverberation, virtual (semi) multi-dimensional mode, and screen depth matching. You can choose from three modes, A/B/C, depending on the characteristics of the mixing studio that actually measured the reverberation in Hollywood.Three DSPs are installed in the audio format decoding and sound field processing section.Dolby Digital and DTS are decoded using a dedicated 24-bit decode DSP, and digital cinema sound is calculated using two 32-bit DSPs developed by Sony for sound field processing.It is equipped with a fully independent 6-channel D/A converter and a 2-channel A/D converter for digital cinema sound processing of analog input.The A/D converter has a 20-bit resolution and the D/A converter supports 96kHz/24b-bit for all channels.A dynamic 5-amp system is used for the amplifier section, and the same power transistor is used for each channel amplifier. This transistor has a built-in temperature compensation circuit, and stable operation is possible even when the transistor is cooled immediately after the power is turned on or when it is heated for a while.Equipped with an analog direct function.If this function is turned ON, the power supply of the video and digital circuits can be stopped depending on the situation, reducing the noise harmful to enjoying the analog source.The frequency response has been expanded to 100 kHz to support next-generation audio formats such as SACD.Equipped with 5.1 channel input jacks.This jack can also be used as an input jack for 3-1 stereo.Component video input / output terminal is mounted.The heat sink is a sf heat sink.This heat sink uses a vibration dispersion fin structure to suppress fin resonance, and by inserting a different rib into each fin, tuning fork resonance is prevented and split vibration is suppressed.In addition, the power amplifier block uses a horizontally opposed construction placed between a pair of sf heat sinks to ensure stable operation by creating a uniform environment with amplifiers for five channels.The power supply section is equipped with a large power transformer that uses a wrapped core.In the conventional EI core transformer, E-type and I-type magnetic steel sheets are individually laminated and then combined to form the core. As a result, there are no faults in the magnetic path, greatly reducing leakage of magnetic flux.A pin-type transformer is used to extract the intermediate voltage from the coil of the transformer. For transformers of this size, lead wires are generally inserted into the coil for connection. However, in the lead type, winding disorder occurs due to swelling of the connection part. In the pin-type transformer, winding disorder does not occur because the coil is directly connected to the terminal, leading to high sound quality.An eccentric insulator is used for the legs.This insulator changes the phase of the transmitted vibration and cancels it by providing a screw hole avoiding the center.Newly developed driver part integrated design is adopted for the display part, and FL tube of 2-line display is adopted.By integrating the driver into the tube as an integrated LSI, it is difficult for lighting noise to leak to the outside of analog circuits. In addition, the two line display increases the amount of information.On-screen capability.Equipped with an FM/AM tuner.Comes with a bi-directional wireless remote with learning and LCD capabilities."

description: "An AV amplifier equipped with Cinema Studio EX, an advanced form of digital cinema sound.Equipped with the Cinema Studio EX mode, you can enjoy a surround sound field of 360 degrees all around.This mode integrates the Cinema Studio Reverbation, which adds the reverberation of the editing theater, the virtual multi-dimensional, which reproduces the virtual multi-rear speaker environment using virtual 3D technology, and the screen depth matching, which realizes the expressive power of depth feeling in the screen direction.It is designed to be used not only as an AV amplifier but also as a pre-main amplifier for pure audio. It is equipped with an analog purity control function.The TA-V777ES not only stops the clock but also shuts off the power supply to the digital system to completely eliminate noise generation. The TA-V 4500 es does not only stop the clock but also shuts off the power supply to the digital system.It is also possible to turn off the power of the video amplifier for audio-only inputs that do not use video circuits. The slow roll-off characteristic has a gentle attenuation characteristic in the band of 20 kHz or higher, so that the transient response is quiet and the sound is comfortable to the ears.Equipped with a headphone theater mode.In this mode, virtual 3D technology is used to eliminate the sense of in-the-head, and additional reverberation is added to improve the sense of spaciousness. This method has the advantages of less uneven winding, higher conversion efficiency, and less vibration of the transformer itself compared with the method of extracting the lead wire by soldering it to the coil.The electrolytic capacitor used in the power supply section is a large 50 mm diameter capacitor made of the same high-sound material used in the TA-N9000ES, taking advantage of the know-how acquired in the development of the TA-N9000ES.An sf heat sink with a vibration dispersion fin structure is adopted for the heat sink to reduce fin resonance.Each fin of this heat sink has ribs placed in different positions to prevent tuning fork resonance, reduce split vibration, and minimize the amount of color added to the music.The FB/SL chassis is a combination of the FB (Frame & Beam) chassis and the SL (Swerve-Less, distortion reduction) structure that adds elements of angle block to the FB (Frame & Beam) chassis. You can store up to five memories.Wireless remote control is included."

name: SS-GR1
description: "The R Series speaker system was developed with original know-how aiming at comfortable and rich sound.The enclosure uses a super-oval enclosure that prevents harmful reflected waves and reduces the concentration of internal sound pressure. This enclosure uses a unique super-oval shape designed by applying a high-order elliptic function to the shape of the round part. It is manufactured by introducing the rounding technique used in the side plate molding of a grand piano.The rounding technique is a time-consuming process in which dozens of plates of approximately 1 mm thickness with different internal losses are stacked, bent, and kneaded together to form a single baffle plate without any cuts. This realizes a smooth shape extending from the front to the side and back. It smoothly diffracts sound waves and creates a unique soft form.We have adopted a resonance control (RC) frame that guides the sound of the enclosure in a better direction while ensuring that the enclosure has sufficient sound insulation characteristics. In the RC frame, a large, robust wooden frame is placed in the center of the enclosure to form the framework of the enclosure with front and rear baffles connected to it. As a result of careful vibration mode control, the structure and sound similar to those of string instruments such as cello and contrabass are realized.In addition, by applying a slanding process to the left and right of the top plate and giving it a function similar to the soundboard used for piano, the sound is made more natural.The speaker unit above the mid-range is equipped with a CD (Constant Directivity) horn, a machined horn with a front baffle. The CD horn performs impedance matching between the vibration system of the unit and air, not only increases the radiation efficiency of sound waves, but also provides excellent directional characteristics for a predetermined radiation angle.In the SS-GR1, the directional range is set to 90 degrees horizontally and 40 degrees vertically on the axis. In the horizontal direction, the sound pressure outside the range is lowered to minimize the reflection of the sound on the wall of the listening room. In the vertical direction, harmful interference between the speaker units is reduced to obtain sound without turbidity.In addition, the horn is machined directly from the baffle plate to reduce harmful horn noise, and there are no steps or grooves at the horn opening to enable smooth sound wave emission.Using a time alignment system, the sound source positions of woofer, mid-range, tweeter, and super tweeter are aligned on a vertical line, and sound waves of all bands are radiated so that they reach the ear equally.The network section has a crossover design of 18dB/oct. with good slope sharpness and the ability to drive all units in positive phase.We also select individual parts through trial listening. For example, we use an iron-core coil for low-frequency sound and an air-core coil for medium-frequency sound. We select the right material for the right place and use it after curing it with a resin mold. We also select capacitors with aluminum electrolytic type, MP type, and film type.In addition, to prevent adverse effects such as electromagnetic induction, the circuit boards of network circuits are separated for each band and fixed together on the bottom plate of the enclosure, which is the most stable in terms of layout.In the low range, a 30 cm cone type woofer using pulp mixed with polyamide fiber for the diaphragm is mounted.By adopting a triple suspension system with a three point support with a damper behind the voice coil, the rolling phenomenon is prevented and the voice coil stroke is stabilized. In addition, the triple suspension system can make the edge material softer than that of the two point support, so compliance (mobility) is increased and distortion in the ultra-low frequency range is reduced.In addition, aluminum die-cast with excellent vibration characteristics is used for the frame, and a sound with less turbidity is achieved by deadning treatment for vibration isolation.The mid-range is equipped with a 10 cm balanced drive mid-range consisting of a cone section made of pulp paper mixed with polyamide fiber and a SiC dome section.The balance drive method places the contact point between the diaphragm and voice coil (bobbin) at the point where the diaphragm can be driven most efficiently. This minimizes harmful split vibration and expands the piston motion range.In addition, both the voice coil and magnetic circuit are larger in the balanced drive than in the general cone type unit, so it contributes to the improvement of the distortion, and the distortion from 1 kHz to 3 kHz, which is easy to be heard, is suppressed to 0.1% or less.In addition, it is housed in an independent back cavity to optimize back pressure.A 3-cm dome type tweeter using SiC for the diaphragm is mounted in the high range.In order to reduce the conversion loss from electricity to sound, we have adopted a surface drive structure in which the voice coil drive is performed outside the diaphragm surface. In the surface drive, the sound wave is generated through the shortest route from the voice coil (bobbin) to the diaphragm surface, so the sound wave is emitted from the diaphragm surface faster than the sound that has passed inside the diaphragm. Therefore, the characteristic sound of the diaphragm itself is hardly generated.A 2 cm dome type super tweeter using biocellulose for the diaphragm is mounted on the super high frequency range.Biocellulose was developed jointly by Sony, Ajinomoto Co., Ltd., and the Research Institute for Fiber and Polymer Materials of the Agency of Industrial Science and Technology. It has a high propagation speed comparable to that of aluminum, an internal loss comparable to that of paper, and an extremely light weight of approximately 0.01g except for the edge.The exterior of the enclosure is finished with a veneer with a walnut."

name: SONY
description: "SONY's No. 1 stand-alone D/A converter.Adhering to the philosophy of the ESPRIT series, we pursue the highest priority for sound quality in all aspects of the circuit configuration, structure, and device.The DAS 702 es is divided into three sections : a digital section, an analog section (including a D/A converter circuit) and a power supply section.In addition to the audio circuit, the D/A converter section that uses a dedicated IC is used independently for Lch/Rch. This fully twin-mono configuration is used to thoroughly pursue sound quality. The digital section contains a clock generator, a data demodulation circuit, and an oversampling digital filter in a shield case to prevent the digital circuit from interfering with the analog and power sections.The PLL circuit for clock generation is divided into Route 3 and composed of optimum circuits and constants for each region.The PLL for the aperture, which is the time reference of the analog signal, is made independent to realize a circuit with high stability.The data demodulation circuit uses a newly developed C-MOS LSI (CX23053) to decode the digital audio interface format input signal into normal 16-bit data, emphasis control signals, and other synchronization signals.An over-sampling digital filter is installed. By increasing the sampling frequency, the band of the noise portion of the digitized signal component shifts to a higher frequency. This eliminates the need for a steep attenuation characteristic of the low-pass filter, which cuts the noise when returning the audio signal. This enables the use of a low-order low-pass filter with less distortion and phase shift.The DAS-0ES uses the CX23034 digital filter that was developed for oversampling and has excellent characteristics such as a passband ripple of less than + 0.01 dB and a stop-global attenuation of more than 80 dB. 702 eS has excellent characteristics.The D/A converter circuit uses a ladder-type IC, which provides current output when 16-bit parallel data is input. This circuit does not require a clock as seen in the integration type, making it very simple.Compared with the integration type, the ladder type tends to have a slightly larger differential non-linearity error and has some disadvantages in terms of the distortion factor in the specification. However, we have obtained good results by adopting it and making the circuit simple.The DAS 702 es uses two of these ICs to simultaneously add input data to the left and right channels to adjust the phase of the L and R channels.To prevent distortion, a sample-and-hold circuit is installed to convert current values into voltage values. This circuit converts the current values into voltage values.The output of the D/A converter circuit shows a new value at an interval of approximately 11 Ï‰ sec (at 44.1 kHz). This value is sampled for approximately 5.5 Ï‰ sec in consideration of a sufficiently stable timing and held for the remaining approximately 5.5 Ï‰ sec.Since this sampling start point is the time reference of the converted analog value, the clock with high time axis accuracy generated by the aperture PLL of the clock generator is used.A low-pal filter is installed to remove high-frequency components outside the audio band contained in the output signal of the sample-and-hold circuit.In terms of circuitry, a GIC-type seventh order Butterworth active filter has been adopted, and audio signal components only pass through the resistance, which has succeeded in minimizing sound quality degradation.The output amplifier is an audio op-amp.Especially fTThe frequency at which the current amplification factor hfe becomes 1 is extended to approximately 700 MHz. The PNP side, which is usually around 1 to 2 MHz, is an excellent process that achieves almost the same performance as the NPN side. The element structure with good thermal balance and IC package with large heat capacity make use of Sony's tradition.In addition, we use a lot of carefully examined materials such as simple and straight transmission by twin mono circuit configuration of L/Rch separation using bus bar, LC-OFC wire material, metal coating resistance, etc.The power supply section includes a large-capacity (190 VA) power transformer with two windings for analog and digital circuits, an ultra-high-speed rectifier diode, and a large ceramic powder electrolytic capacitor with a total capacitance of approximately 33,000 Ï‰ F. The power supply section has sufficient space. The wiring material used is LC-OFC, a type I oxygen-free copper with a purity of 99.995% or more and with significantly fewer crystal boundaries.The chassis is designed to be highly rigid. As a measure against vibration, the main printed circuit board (analog part / power supply part) and the shield case of the digital circuit are fixed with a 4mm-thick aluminum bottom plate and a 10mmx15mm-square aluminum material.In addition, the top plate is a 3mm-thick aluminum plate, and damping materials are also used. The entire chassis is vibration-proof structure using a lot of non-magnetic materials to prevent magnetic distortion.Since the digital audio interface transmits two L and R channel data in a single line, it uses a time division multiplex transmission method in which L channel data and R channel data are alternately transmitted and received.When the sampling frequency is 44.1 kHz, 88,200 data are transmitted on both channels at a rate of 44,100 data per second. The length of each channel data section is 11.34 Ï‰ sec. Each word consists of 32 bits. The first 4 bits are the SYNC part for synchronization, the next is the 24-bit field for audio data, and the last 4 bits are the part for emphasis ON/OFF and information accompanying data such as subcodes.The data thus assembled is subjected to a modulation called biphase mark, in which data 0 is inverted once and data 1 is inverted twice. However, in the SYNC part, a special pattern called preamble is embedded, and the inversion by data is ignored, so that the duration of high level is longer than other parts.The D/A converter uses this preamble part for synchronization.Equipped with an indicator capable of automatic switching for sampling frequency of 32kHz/44.1kHz/48kHz.Equipped with two digital input / output terminals.The line-out terminal is gold-plated with two systems, FIX (fixed) and VARIABLE (variable).It uses a variable volume with carefully examined sound quality, and the level of line output and headphone output can be adjusted."

name: SONY
description: "D/A converter, the successor to DAS 702 es.The layout of the DAS 703 es is divided into three parts, digital part, analog part and power supply part, and the construction is simple and follows the signal flow.In addition, the digital part is contained in a shield case, and an optical transfer method using light is adopted for data transmission from the digital part to the analog part, which prevents the digital circuit from interfering with the analog circuit and degrading the sound quality.We have reduced the size of the digital circuit in order to maximize the advantages of the digital separate system.The digital circuit consists mainly of a data demodulation circuit and an oversampling digital filter. The data demodulation is processed by a single LSI (CX 23053) developed for the decoder.The digital filter uses an LSI (CX 23034), which has an excellent filter attenuation of more than 80 dB.A high-precision double PLL clock generation circuit is used for clock generation.The clock required for the digital filter and data demodulation circuit must accurately track the jitter in the input signal, but the clock for the sample-and-hold circuit is the time axis of the analog output signal and must be prevented from tracking the jitter.Taking these points into consideration, the DAS 703 es is designed as a high-precision double PLL that combines two PLLs with different characteristics : a digital PLL of jitter tracking type and an analog PLL of jitter non-tracking type.An optical transfer method using an optical transmission element (photocoupler) is adopted for data transmission from digital circuit to analog circuit, which reduces various distortion and noise caused by ground current.We have adopted a ladder type D/A converter IC.In the ladder type, when 16-bit parallel data is input, a current corresponding to each bit is generated first, and then the sum is obtained through a resistor network called a ladder.The DAS 703 es uses a current-output type, which is larger and more robust than the voltage-output type, which uses the internal resistance of the IC. It is also designed to use the voltage conversion itself as a sample-and-hold circuit. This effectively eliminates the need for an amplifier and provides fresher sound quality.Equipped with a direct sample-and-hold circuit.The sample-and-hold circuit samples only the latter half of the D/A converter IC, where the data is stable, and holds this value until the next stable data comes. This is because the output of the sample-and-hold circuit is distorted if the unstable value immediately after conversion of the input data of the D/A converter IC is output as it is.The direct sample-and-hold circuit also directly converts current to voltage.The analog low-pass filter uses a GIC type 7th order Butterworth active filter.The output of the analog filter is output through an output amplifier that also serves as a de-emphasis circuit.The DAS 703 es output amplifier combines a cascode dual FET with no capacity distortion at the first stage and a power MOS FET buffer circuit with a large current capacity at the output stage. This amplifier has sufficient volume and high-quality mid - and high-range.The chassis is made to be a tough one by rationally combining structural materials of sufficient thickness and strength.The insulator uses a vibration suppression structure that combines ceramics and non-resilient rubber.The power supply section uses dedicated large transformers for both digital and analog circuits.The analog one has a core volume that can make a power amplifier of about 100W. Also, the digital one is a little bit small but has a capacity that can cover the whole normal CD player.Ceramic powder dispersion type electrolytic capacitor is adopted for electrolytic capacitor.This condenser improves sound quality by dispersing fine ceramic powder in the electrolytic solution to activate the movement of abnormal noise in the electrolytic solution.An ES board is used for the printed circuit board.The resist coating on general printed circuit boards increases the capacitance between patterns, which has an effect on sound quality. On ES boards, the resist between patterns is removed to ensure sound quality with less hardness and distortion.Resin molded acoustic resistor is used for the resistor.Carbon film with a gold-plated cap The resistance element is molded with hard resin to improve sound quality and vibration. The DAS 703 es uses large, high-quality resistors for the NFB circuit and GIC filter to improve sound quality.Digital Tape and Digital Rec out terminals are provided as dedicated input terminals for DAT and other devices.If you press the Digital Tape Monitor switch on the panel, the input from Digital Input1/2 will be cut off and the input from this jack will be handled. name: DAS-R1
description: "This is a D/A converter that converts digital signals into analog signals with extremely high precision and eliminates resonance.The digital filter is an 18-bit type with 8 x oversampling.The sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz input from a CD player is converted to 352.8 kHz, which is 8 times the sampling frequency. This greatly increases the information density and reduces the load on the analog filter to improve sound quality.In addition, the DAS-R1 digital filter has an extremely high order of 293 order, so it has excellent characteristics such as a ripple within ¥0.00001 dB within the band, a preecho of -124dB or less, and a displacement of 120 dB or more at 150 kHz. Moreover, the calculation error is much smaller than the final output of the 18-bit calculation value, so it is virtually error-free.In order to reduce requantization noise, we have introduced a calculation method called noise shaping.In this method, errors in the data are always accumulated, and the accumulated errors are also considered when rounding to determine the output.The D/A conversion method uses the overlap staggered D/A conversion method.In this method, two D/A converter ICs operating at 4 fs per channel are used, and the output is synthesized with the operation timing shifted by half a cycle. The two D/A converters alternately receive 8 times over-sampled data, and overlap operation is performed.The feature of this method is that the aperture effect, which is a kind of filter characteristic, starts at 4 fs even though it is 8 fs D/A conversion. This eliminates dither noise caused by noise shaping that concentrates near 4 fs.As a result of the overlapping operation, the distortion and noise are averaged, and the distortion factor is improved by up to 3 dB compared with the case where the D/A converter is used alone. Moreover, the output current is doubled, and the SN ratio is improved by up to 6 dB.The FB chassis is used to eliminate unnecessary vibration and resonance.It consists of a frame around the perimeter and several beams connecting the previous and next frames, each of which is thick enough to be firmly joined together.The power supply section is equipped with dedicated power transformers for both digital and analog power supplies to reduce mutual interference.In addition, the power supply section has enough space to occupy approximately 2/3 of the internal space to compensate for stable power supply.In addition to the twin-link optical input terminal for connection with CDP-R1, two coaxial input terminals are installed.The digital input automatically corresponds to three sampling frequencies : 32 khz, 44.1 khz and 48 khz.You can also determine the source of the program being played by using an indicator that shows the sampling frequency during operation and the Digital Input indicator linked to the input selector switch."

name: DAS-R1A
description: "R series D/A converter equipped with high density linear converter system composed mainly of pulse D/A converter.A pulse D/A converter uses one current source and one electronic switch and has only two output values, high (current flow) and low (no current flow). And all the intermediate values of audio waveforms are obtained by the time average of the pulse output, which is the spread of the binary output in the time axis direction. Therefore, in principle, the differential non-linear distortion caused by the error of the current source, the glitch and 0 cross distortion caused by the difference in the operation timing of the electronic switch, which are unavoidable in the conventional D/A converter, do not occur.The Pulse D/A converter achieves a maximum operating frequency of 50 MHz for the master clock and 50 million pulses per second. The Sony Extended Noise Shaping calculation method is used to calculate the pulses, and a high dynamic range is achieved by generating a high-density pulse train.The DAS-R1a uses two pulse D/A converters in complimentary service mode to cancel harmonic distortion with auxiliary positive - and negative-phase outputs and to increase the S / N ratio by doubling the output current.The CDP-R1a and DAS-R1a use the Twin Link S method, which enables one master clock, in order to realize a more complete separate type.Apart from the data tradition from the player side to the converter, it is equipped with an interface that sends a clock signal from the converter side to the player. This is structured so that both units are connected by two optical cables in a round trip, and data read from the disk can be sent out in synchronization with the movement of the D/A converter.The master clock is placed so close to the pulse D/A converter that it can be said that it is directly attached, and a direct digital sync circuit for rearranging the data on the chip of the pulse D/A converter is mounted. This realizes a clean D/A conversion without jitter.We have also developed a logical synchronous circuit based on a high-purity twin PLL interface purity twin PLL interface with less leakage of digital noise, and developed an interface IC with this built-in circuit.The characteristics are improved by installing a low-jitter optical input unit.FB chassis is adopted for the chassis structure.This chassis is made of metal material of sufficient thickness and strength, and the whole chassis is joined by a frame surrounding the outer circumference and beams before and after passing the front and rear. This structure ensures almost total strength only by this frame and beams.It is fixed directly on the most neutral beam with low vibration without using any special metal fittings when mounting the mechanism and substrate.The legs are made of fine ceramic insulators combined with rubber with good braking performance.The power supply section is equipped with two transformers, one for the interface and the other for the audio, to reduce mutual interference between circuits handling different types of signals. In addition, to reduce the noise of the transformer due to its structure, it is stored in the transformer case filled with resin.It is equipped with a multi-interface function that automatically responds to 32 khz, 44.1 khz and 48 khz, and is also compatible with DAT decks and BS tuners."

name: SONY
description: "An R10 series D/A converter that uses a current pulse D/A converter.The newly developed current-pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.The current pulse D/A converter is a single-bit D/A converter that uses current pulses. In the D/A converter, digital data is converted into a pulse train. In the conventional D/A converter, the pulse train is represented by a voltage. The voltage value that represents the pulse height is the power supply voltage applied to the converter IC. If the power supply voltage does not fluctuate, there is no problem. In reality, however, the power supply voltage fluctuates depending on the current consumption, and the height of the pulse train fluctuates slightly. In addition, since it is a voltage pulse, it is difficult to completely prevent the mixing of voltage noise generated by the arithmetic circuit, etc.. To avoid these problems, it is necessary to review the fact that the pulse is represented by a voltage.The current pulse D/A converter used in the DAS-R10 converts the physical quantity used for D/A conversion from voltage to current, and is not affected by the noise of the arithmetic circuit, thus improving sound quality.A current pulse is generated by alternately distributing a single DC current to two circuits. When a current flows through one circuit (when there is a pulse), the other circuit becomes 0, so that a pair of positive and negative current pulses are obtained. This allows perfect balance transmission over the entire audio signal path from the time of signal generation, reducing the influence of noise.The current-pulse D/A converter has a feature of eliminating power supply voltage fluctuations and is rich in low-frequency expression. In addition, the newly developed complex voltage-current conversion circuit (CIV circuit), which converts current pulses into voltage waveforms, has noise elimination performance. Therefore, compared with voltage-type pulse D/A converters, there is less noise in the output signal, and a low-order low-pass filter with good group delay characteristics can be used as a low-pass filter in the latter stage. In addition, the CIV circuit itself has excellent performance in that there is no group delay degradation in the audio band good results such as high S/N ratio, sense of orientation, and sense of scale are obtained.The digital filter uses a DSP parallel FIR type digital filter.With conventional digital data, when the data is oversampled by 8 times, the original data is doubled to create intermediate data, and the next data is doubled. Each time intermediate data is created, new data is filled in between the original data and the data. With this serial method, there is a rounding error at the time of intermediate data creation, and this error accumulates every time operations are repeated.The DAS-R10 uses eight DSPs, which have more computing power than a digital filter, and uses a parallel computing circuit that produces eight times more data than the original data at once, thus minimizing computation errors.All the analog signal paths, including the current pulse D/A converter, are made of discrete component without the use of integrated circuits. Therefore, there are no restrictions associated with the use of ICs, and the performance is maximized.In addition, there is no risk of noise contamination from the power supply system through the silicon substrate, which cannot be avoided with ICs.A metal core module is used for the amplifier circuit.This system consists of a metal core (metal substrate) made of aluminum alloy, heat-resistant insulating treatment, copper circuit patterns, and surface mounted components. The metal core itself is a metal with good thermal conductivity, so the heat balance of the circuit as a whole is extremely good. In addition, since it is divided into modules, it is more resistant to external vibration. In addition, surface mounted components do not have lead wires, so the contact between the lead wire and the component body can be omitted, and the vibration of the lead wire itself can be eliminated.The motherboard for the digital circuit section and the D/A converter section uses a 4-layer board to connect signals at the shortest distance and to deploy power and ground on the entire surface.As with the metal core module, surface mounting is positively adopted for mounting the components on the motherboard, shortening the signal path and improving the mounting density of the components.The operation program of the DSP can be switched by the filter switch on the front panel. In the DAS-R10, the operation program is supplied from a ROM (read-only memory) installed outside the operation block. In addition to the normal ROM which is the standard mode, the ROM with the optional program written is installed, and it can be switched according to compatibility with the system and source."

name: SONY
description: "A surround processor that supports Dolby Pro Logic Surround.In addition to the delay of the audio signal, the matrix synthesis corresponding to each surround position is processed by a digital circuit. This eliminates the phase rotation of the delay sound, which tends to occur with analog delay, and provides a surround effect with excellent sense of localization.At the center of this digital circuit is a newly developed C-MOS IC, High-speed Presence Synthesizer CXD 1079. In addition, by integrating the interface into one chip, digital noise and unnecessary radiation, which are problems in digital audio equipment, are greatly reduced.The A/D and D/A converters are linear with 16-bit quantization bits and an integral type with a sampling frequency of 48.0 kHz. description: "This MD deck has a common design with Sony's compact component system #3000 series.We have introduced a wide bit stream technology that greatly expands the dynamic range and improves sound quality by increasing the number of bits in the digital circuit from 16 bits to more bits from the input system to the output system.Based on this digital processing, the MDS-J3000 incorporates the current pulse D/A converter used in the ES Series CD player in the D/A converter section. This makes it possible to play music more efficiently because it has a stable current source and is not affected by voltage fluctuations.Equipped with a sampling rate converter that automatically converts each sampling frequency of 48 kHz or 32 kHz to 44.1 kHz.In addition, it is equipped with two optical input terminals and one coaxial input terminal for digital recording of various sources.The power supply section uses an R-core transformer with no breaks in the iron core of the transformer and a circular doughnut type in cross section to greatly reduce magnetic flux leakage and vibration.With the built-in Music Sync Recording function, it is also possible to record with other companies' CD players.Simply by pressing the Music Sync button on the remote control and then starting playback of the connected CD player or cassette deck, recording will start automatically upon detection of the incoming music signal. name: SONY
description: "This MD deck inherits the high sound quality design of MDS-JA555ES, and is equipped with MDLP mode and S. F edit.It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system.ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality.As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency.In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5.5 kHz, middle band from 5.5 kHz to 11 kHz, and high band from 11 kHz to 22 kHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3 divided it into four bands (high band divided into 11 kHz to 16.5 kHz and 16.5 kHz to 22 kHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1,024 samples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it.In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11.6 ms in ATRAC). ATRAC3 controls the content of signal processing precisely every 1 ms so that appropriate signal processing can continue even when the nature of music suddenly changes.Furthermore, ATRAC3 has a new step called tone component separation, which extracts tone components and encodes (compresses) them separately from other components in order to maintain high sound quality.The MDLP has two modes : LP2 stereo recording (playback) mode, which enables recording at twice the disc recording time, and LP4 stereo recording mode, which enables recording at four times the disc recording time.The LP2 stereo recording (playback) mode reflects the high compression ratio of ATRAC3 and is suitable for long-duration music recording and playback. The LP4 stereo recording (playback) mode uses a compression method that allocates a large number of bits for center localization signals (vocals, bass, etc.), which play an important role in music signals. By reducing the amount of data to be recorded, the LP2 stereo recording (playback) mode even longer recording times.The MDLP cannot be recorded or played with the conventional model because the data allocation on the disk is different from the conventional format. However, the MDLP compatible model can record or play with the conventional format.Also, high-speed recording in the MDLP format is up to 2 x speed, and S. F Edit cannot be performed on discs recorded in the MDLP format.The ATRAC DSP employs a Type-R DSP for ATRAC with twice the signal processing capability of the conventional DSP. In addition, the Intelligent Bit Re-Location Algorithm makes full use of the increased processing capability and re-analyzes the spectrum converted music data to search for minute levels of redundant bit allocation that have been difficult to find until now, and redistributes the bits preferentially to the frequency bands that are important for the listener. This further refines the bit allocation and makes it closer to the waveform of the original music source.By introducing wide bit stream technology, the dynamic range of the core ATRAC DSP and the audio data word length of peripheral circuits such as digital in / out have been increased from 16 bits to more bits, enabling recording and playback with a wide dynamic range.It is equipped with a VC24plus that combines a 24-bit (V. C) digital filter and an S-TACT pulse generator that generates clean pulses. C. = Variable Coefficient) digital filter allows you to change the cutoff characteristics of the filter during playback so that you can obtain subtle changes in sound quality. F Edit (Scale Factor Edit) function allows you to adjust the volume and fade in / out after recording. The scale factor is a parameter that represents the peak above the level of a 52-part floating unit. You can adjust the volume by changing this value. With this function, even if the recording level of a disc becomes uneven, you can adjust it later. This function reads the recorded data from the disc, edits the data, and writes it back to the disc.It is equipped with a sampling rate converter that automatically converts 32 kHz and 48 kHz sampling frequency to 44.1 kHz.A current pulse D/A converter is used for the D/A converter.The pulse output as voltage is replaced with a current that is less affected by voltage-induced noise and transmitted. It has a stable current source and is not affected by voltage fluctuations, making it possible to achieve excellent low-frequency playback.The power supply section uses an R-core transformer with no gaps in the core of the transformer and a circular doughnut type in cross section to greatly reduce magnetic flux leakage and vibration.The chassis structure is made of metal material with sufficient strength. The FB chassis is firmly fixed as one box with a frame surrounding the outer circumference and beams passed in front and back. By combining members of different shapes and sizes, natural vibrations are mutually cancelled, and vibration of the chassis as a whole is greatly reduced.It uses an eccentric insulator whose mounting hole to the chassis is offset from the center. name: SONY
description: "152 mm wide compact MD deck with PC Link Kit.PC and USB connection is possible with the included PC link kit PCLK-MN10.This allows you to play / stop MD/PC CD (music CD in PC CD-ROM), start a song, fast forward / rewind, and perform other basic operations from your PC. In addition, the Intelligent Bit Re-Location Algorithm makes full use of the increased processing capability and re-analyzes the spectrum converted music data to search for minute levels of redundant bit allocation that have been difficult to find until now, and redistributes the bits preferentially to the frequency bands that are important for the listener. This further refines the bit allocation and makes it closer to the waveform of the original music source.By introducing wide bit stream technology, the dynamic range of the core ATRAC DSP and the audio data word length of peripheral circuits such as digital in / out have been increased from 16 bits to more bits, enabling recording and playback with a wide dynamic range.It is equipped with the MDLP mode, which is an improvement of the ATRAC audio compression technology and realizes about twice the compression performance of the conventional system.ATRAC reduces the data size by eliminating sound components that are hard to hear. ATRAC3, which is used in the MDLP mode, further improves the compression ratio while minimizing degradation of sound quality.As one example, we have adopted a data encoding method called Huffman coding, which focuses on the frequency of data occurrence. Shorter codes are assigned to frequently occurring data sequences, and longer codes are assigned to infrequently occurring data sequences to improve compression efficiency.In addition, in order to maintain high sound quality even with high compression, we are also improving the accuracy of band division and spectrum blocking, which are pre-processes for compression processing, prior to compression processing. As for band division, conventional ATRAC divided it into three bands (low band up to 5.5 kHz, middle band from 5.5 kHz to 11 kHz, and high band from 11 kHz to 22 kHz) and passed it to the next circuit. However, ATRAC3 divided it into four bands (high band divided into 11 kHz to 16.5 kHz and 16.5 kHz to 22 kHz) to allow extra processing space. Spectrum blocking is divided into 1,024 samples, which is twice as large as ATRAC, and employs a circuit configuration that recognizes the signal more finely and compresses it.In MD, data consisting of one pair of Lch and Rch is recorded alternately at a fixed time interval (11.6 ms in ATRAC). The LP4 stereo recording (playback) mode uses a compression method that allocates a large number of bits for center localization signals (vocals, bass, etc.), which play an important role in music signals. By reducing the amount of data to be recorded, the LP2 stereo recording (playback) mode even longer recording times.The MDLP cannot be recorded or played with the conventional model because the data allocation on the disk is different from the conventional format. However, the MDLP compatible model can record or play with the conventional format.Also, high-speed recording in the MDLP format is up to 2 x speed, and S. F Edit cannot be performed on discs recorded in the MDLP format.The S. F Edit (Scale Factor Edit) function allows you to adjust the volume and fade in / out after recording. The scale factor is a parameter that represents the peak above the level of a 52-part floating unit. You can adjust the volume by changing this value. With this function, even if the recording level of a disc becomes uneven, you can adjust it later.
